statement.id: Dalam agama rakyat Estonia, maa-alused adalah makhluk misterius mirip peri yang hidup di bawah tanah.
statement.en: In Estonian folk religion, maa-alused are mysterious elf-like creatures that live beneath the ground.

basis_claims.quote: They were believed to have a parallel existence to that of humans, the principal differences being that all orientations are reversed, such that up becomes down and left becomes right, and that all things possessed by them are diminished in size.

statement.id: Mereka dipercaya hidup sejajar dengan manusia, dengan perbedaan utama bahwa semua arah terbalik, atas menjadi bawah dan kiri menjadi kanan, dan semua milik mereka berukuran lebih kecil.
statement.en: They were believed to live a parallel existence to humans, the main differences being that all orientations are reversed, up becoming down and left becoming right, and that everything they own is smaller in size.

basis_claims.quote: Maa-alused (ka maahaldjad) olid algselt surnud olendid, kes hiljem elasid maa või põranda all.

statement.id: Maa-alused (juga disebut maahaldjad) semula adalah makhluk yang sudah mati, yang kemudian hidup di bawah tanah atau di bawah lantai.
statement.en: Maa-alused (also maahaldjad) were originally dead beings who later lived under the ground or under the floor.

basis_claims.quote: Maa-alused olid tuntud pisikeste inimesekujuliste mütoloogiliste olenditena põhiliselt Põhja-Eestis, nende olemasolust andsid märku hääled. Nad tegutsesid seppade (taovad tiks-tiks) ja kangrutena, maa peale ilmusid ka putuka või loomana (harilikult konnana). Neile tehtud heategude eest tasusid rikkalikult.

statement.id: Maa-alused dikenal sebagai makhluk mitos kecil berwujud manusia, terutama di Estonia Utara (Põhja-Eesti), yang keberadaannya ditandai suara-suara; mereka bekerja sebagai pandai besi (berbunyi tiks-tiks) dan penenun, muncul di atas tanah sebagai serangga atau hewan (biasanya katak), dan membalas kebaikan dengan murah hati.
statement.en: Maa-alused were known as tiny human-shaped mythical beings mainly in North Estonia (Põhja-Eesti), whose presence was signalled by sounds; they worked as smiths (hammering tiks-tiks) and weavers, appeared above ground as insects or animals (usually frogs), and repaid good deeds generously.

basis_claims.quote: is a night spirit (Bogeyman) in Slavic folklore. According to beliefs, he abducts children who do not sleep at night or behave badly. He is also called Babayka (Russian: Бабайка), Babayko (Ukrainian: Бабайко) or Bobo (Babok, Bebok) (Polish)

statement.id: Babay (Бабай) adalah roh malam (momok) dalam cerita rakyat Slavia yang menculik anak yang tidak tidur atau nakal; juga disebut Babayka, Babayko (Ukraina), atau Bobo (Polandia).
statement.en: Babay is a night spirit (bogeyman) of Slavic folklore who abducts children who do not sleep or behave badly; also called Babayka, Babayko (Ukrainian) or Bobo (Polish).

basis_claims.quote: Babay is rarely described, so that children can imagine him in the form most terrible for them, but sometimes Babay is described as a pitch-black and crooked old man. He has some physical defects, such as muteness, armlessness, and/or lameness. He has a bag and a cane.

statement.id: Babay jarang digambarkan agar anak membayangkannya dalam wujud paling menakutkan, tetapi kadang ia lelaki tua hitam bengkok dengan cacat seperti bisu, tak berlengan, atau pincang, membawa karung dan tongkat; ia tinggal di hutan, rawa, atau kebun.
statement.en: Babay is rarely described so children imagine their worst form, but sometimes he is a pitch-black crooked old man with defects like muteness, armlessness or lameness, carrying a bag and cane; he lives in the forest, a swamp or a garden.

statement.en: King Alfons II of Aragon sent the old noble Arnald Estruc to Llers Castle (Alt Empordà) to fight paganism and witchcraft, where he was killed in 1173; afterwards he sucked villagers' blood and impregnated young women, who after nine months bore monstrous newborns dead at birth.

basis_claims.quote: Malgrat que l'autor afirma que la seva obra es basa en una llegenda que ell mateix recuperà d'una història del segle xii, mai no n'ha establert la fidelitat ni n'ha aportat cap prova. ... fa que, en general, els historiadors neguin la veracitat de la suposada llegenda i sostinguin que no hi ha rastres històrics de la figura d'Estruch.

statement.id: Para sejarawan umumnya menolak kebenaran legenda yang diklaim itu dan berpendapat tidak ada jejak sejarah sosok Estruch; penulisnya tidak pernah membuktikan sumber abad ke-12 yang ia klaim.

basis_claims.quote: is a vampire in Polish folklore. According to legend, some people are born with the destiny of becoming vjesci, discernible by a caul located on the newborn's head. basis_claims.quote: the vjesci did not die, instead returning to life at midnight after its burial and eating its clothes and some of its own flesh. statement.en: The vjesci did not die but rose at midnight after burial, ate its clothes and some of its flesh, left the grave to eat family and neighbours, then rang the church bell; those who heard it were its next victims.

dhampir.aura: Focused vampire-hunter presence through large eyes, prominent nose, flute ritual and tense village-alley gaze.

basis_claims.quote: In Balkan folklore, a dhampir ... is a mythical creature that is the result of a union between a vampire and a human.

statement.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Balkan, dhampir adalah makhluk mitos hasil hubungan antara vampir dan manusia.
statement.en: In Balkan folklore, a dhampir is a mythical creature resulting from a union between a vampire and a human.

basis_claims.quote: Legends state that dhampirs were, for the most part, normal members of the community. But dhampirs, especially males of paternal vampire descent, could see invisible vampires and practise sorcery, often starting careers as vampire hunters, which would be practiced for generations from father to son.

statement.id: Menurut legenda, dhampir umumnya warga biasa, tetapi mereka, terutama laki-laki keturunan ayah vampir, dapat melihat vampir tak kasatmata dan mempraktikkan sihir, sering menjadi pemburu vampir turun-temurun dari ayah ke anak.
statement.en: Legends say dhampirs were mostly ordinary community members, but they, especially males with a vampire father, could see invisible vampires and practise sorcery, often becoming vampire hunters from father to son.

basis_claims.quote: In contrast, a pronounced nose was often a sign, as were larger than normal ears, teeth, or eyes.

statement.id: Tanda lain adalah hidung yang menonjol serta telinga, gigi, atau mata yang lebih besar dari biasa.
statement.en: Other signs were a prominent nose and unusually large ears, teeth or eyes.

basis_claims.quote: 外見は普通の人間と変わらないが、不死である吸血鬼を殺す力を持つ。また、吸血鬼を探知する能力も備える。

statement.id: Penampilan dhampir tidak berbeda dari manusia biasa, tetapi ia memiliki kekuatan untuk membunuh vampir yang abadi serta kemampuan mendeteksi vampir.
statement.en: A dhampir looks like an ordinary human but has the power to kill the undying vampire and the ability to detect vampires.

basis_claims.quote: ダンピールによる吸血鬼退治は、儀式のような形式を取る。笛を吹いたり、走り回ったり、目に見えない敵と戦った後、勝利を宣言する。

statement.id: Perburuan vampir oleh dhampir berbentuk seperti ritual: meniup seruling, berlari ke sana kemari, dan bertarung dengan musuh tak terlihat, lalu menyatakan kemenangan.
statement.en: A dhampir's vampire hunt takes a ritual form: blowing a flute, running about and fighting an invisible foe, then declaring victory.

statement.en: The Little People of the Pryor Mountains (known as Nirumbee or Awwakkulé in the Crow language) are a race of ferocious dwarfs in the folklore of the Crow Tribe, a Native American tribe.

basis_claims.quote: live in the Pryor Mountains, a small mountain range in Carbon County, Montana and Bighorn County, Montana.

basis_claims.quote: The Little People are said to be no more than 18 inches (46 cm) (or knee) high.
basis_claims.locator: The Little People of the Pryor Mountains

basis_claims.quote: and incredibly strong but short arms and legs; and little or no neck.
basis_claims.locator: The Little People of the Pryor Mountains

statement.en: They are described as incredibly strong but with short arms and legs and little or no neck.

basis_claims.quote: Regardless of how they are thought of, the Crow teach respect for these powerful beings; they are to be treated as Elders.

basis_claims.quote: The Little People are described as dwarves that are both human and supernatural beings that can act as spiritual guides for the Crow Tribe.

statement.en: The Little People are described as dwarves that are both human and supernatural beings and can act as spiritual guides for the Crow Tribe.

basis_claims.quote: They dislike ashes, artificial light, salt, and baptisms. They commonly wore green clothes.

basis_claims.quote: The Ferrish have been described as a particular tribe of fairies, standing between one and three foot tall, who rode horses and kept dogs for hunting, having no named king or queen. They were known to replace human babies with changelings

statement.en: The Ferrish are described as a particular tribe of fairies one to three foot tall, who rode horses and kept hunting dogs, with no named king or queen, known to replace human babies with changelings.

basis_claims.quote: They are supposed to be like human beings in form and feature, though very much smaller and more delicately constructed.
basis_claims.locator: Chapter III: Fairies and Familiar Spirits of the Isle of Man

statement.id: Mereka dipercaya mirip manusia dalam bentuk dan rupa, tetapi jauh lebih kecil dan lebih halus bentuknya.
statement.en: They are supposed to be like human beings in form and feature, though very much smaller and more delicately constructed.

basis_claims.quote: They are usually represented as being clad in blue or green, with red peaked caps. They live in green hill sides, more especially affecting the ancient tumuli.

statement.id: Mereka biasanya digambarkan berpakaian biru atau hijau dengan topi runcing merah, dan tinggal di lereng bukit hijau, terutama di gundukan makam kuno (tumuli).
statement.en: They are usually represented clad in blue or green with red peaked caps, living in green hill sides, especially the ancient tumuli.

sanziana.aura: Gentle fairy presence through serene gaze, white festival dress, Galium bouquet and quiet mountain sunset.

basis_claims.quote: Sânziană is the Romanian name for gentle fairies who play an important part in local folklore, also used to designate the Galium verum or Cruciata laevipes flowers. Under the plural form Sânziene, the word designates an annual festival in the fairies' honor.

statement.id: Sânziană adalah nama Rumania untuk peri lembut yang penting dalam cerita rakyat, juga nama bunga Galium verum atau Cruciata laevipes; bentuk jamak Sânziene berarti perayaan tahunan untuk para peri.
statement.en: Sânziană is the Romanian name for gentle fairies important in folklore, also for the Galium verum or Cruciata laevipes flowers; the plural Sânziene names an annual festival in their honour.

basis_claims.quote: The folk practices of Sânziene imply that the most beautiful maidens in the village dress in white and spend all day searching for and picking flowers, of which one MUST be Galium verum

statement.id: Dalam adat Sânziene, gadis-gadis tercantik desa berbaju putih sepanjang hari mencari dan memetik bunga, salah satunya harus Galium verum, lalu menganyam mahkota bunga dan menari mengelilingi api unggun.
statement.en: In Sânziene custom, the village's most beautiful maidens dress in white and pick flowers all day, one of which must be Galium verum, then weave crowns and dance around a bonfire.

basis_claims.quote: Sânzienele sunt, în mitologia românească, zâne bune din clasa ielelor, dar care atunci când nu le este respectată sărbătoarea devin surate cu rusaliile, care sunt zâne rele.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Rumania, Sânziene adalah peri baik dari golongan iele, tetapi bila hari rayanya tidak dihormati mereka menjadi sejenis rusalii, peri jahat.
statement.en: In Romanian mythology the Sânziene are good fairies of the iele class, but when their feast is not respected they become kin to the rusalii, who are evil fairies.

basis_claims.quote: în straturile mai recente ale folclorului apare și o zână individualizată, Iana Sânziana (sora Soarelui în colindele cosmologice)

statement.id: Dalam lapisan cerita rakyat yang lebih baru muncul peri tunggal, Iana Sânziana, saudari Matahari dalam colinde kosmologis.
statement.en: In more recent layers of folklore a single fairy appears, Iana Sânziana, sister of the Sun in cosmological carols.

basis_claims.quote: is a character in East Slavic folktales and bylinas, the tsar of the sea realms. The best known examples are bylinas about Sadko and fairy tales about Vasilisa the Wise, such as The Sea Tsar and Vasilisa the Wise.

statement.id: Tsar Laut adalah tokoh dalam dongeng dan bylina (epos lisan) Slavia Timur, raja alam laut; contoh paling terkenal adalah bylina tentang Sadko dan dongeng tentang Vasilisa yang Bijak, seperti The Sea Tsar and Vasilisa the Wise.
statement.en: The Sea Tsar is a character of East Slavic folktales and bylinas (oral epics), the tsar of the sea realms; the best-known examples are the bylinas about Sadko and the fairy tales about Vasilisa the Wise, such as The Sea Tsar and Vasilisa the Wise.

basis_claims.quote: персонаж русских народных сказок и былин: хозяин дна морского, повелитель всех вод, владыка над подводными обитателями, владелец несметных сокровищ.

statement.id: Artikel Rusia menyebutnya tokoh dongeng dan bylina rakyat Rusia: tuan dasar laut, penguasa semua perairan, raja para penghuni bawah air, dan pemilik harta tak terhitung; ia juga disebut Царь Водяник, Поддонный царь, dan Заморский царь.
statement.en: The Russian article calls him a character of Russian folktales and bylinas: master of the sea floor, lord of all waters, ruler of the underwater dwellers and owner of countless treasures; he is also called Царь Водяник, Поддонный царь and Заморский царь.

basis_claims.quote: Дворец Морского царя, сделанный из хрусталя, серебра, золота и драгоценных камней, помещается неопределённо: то в синем море, то на острове, то в Ильмень-озере. Когда он пляшет и развлекается — на море шторм и поднимается буря.

statement.id: Istana Tsar Laut dari kristal, perak, emas, dan batu permata letaknya tidak tetap: kadang di laut biru, kadang di sebuah pulau, kadang di Danau Ilmen; ketika ia menari dan bersenang-senang, laut bergolak dan badai pun datang.
statement.en: The Sea Tsar's palace of crystal, silver, gold and precious stones is placed vaguely: now in the blue sea, now on an island, now in Lake Ilmen; when he dances and makes merry, the sea storms and a tempest rises.

basis_claims.quote: Эти водяные, с одутловатым брюхом и опухшим лицом, живущие в омутах, особенно около мельниц, известные пьяницы, посещающие кабаки, играющие в кости, ворующие лошадей и коров и топящие людей, — совершенно отличны от былинного морского царя, который живёт в богатых палатах и изображается страстным любителем музыки.

statement.id: Para vodyanoy berperut gembung dan berwajah bengkak yang tinggal di lubuk dekat penggilingan, mabuk-mabukan, main dadu, mencuri kuda dan sapi, serta menenggelamkan orang, sama sekali berbeda dengan Tsar Laut bylina yang tinggal di istana mewah dan digambarkan sebagai pencinta musik.
statement.en: The vodyanoy, with bloated bellies and swollen faces, living in pools especially near mills, drinking, playing dice, stealing horses and cows and drowning people, are wholly different from the Sea Tsar of the bylinas, who lives in rich halls and is portrayed as a passionate lover of music.

basis_claims.quote: is the mythological mining spirit. The legend of Shubin is distributed mainly in the mining towns of the Donbas region on the Russia–Ukraine border. In the north one can hear several legends about the spirit of the mines. The spirit is usually good, but can be wicked.

statement.id: Shubin (Шубін) adalah roh tambang mitologis; legendanya terutama tersebar di kota-kota tambang Donbas di perbatasan Rusia dan Ukraina (Russia, Ukraine); roh ini biasanya baik tetapi bisa jahat.
statement.en: Shubin is the mythological mining spirit; his legend spreads mainly in the mining towns of the Donbas on the Russia–Ukraine border; the spirit is usually good but can be wicked.

basis_claims.quote: (1) the nickname of a miner, whose soul, according to legend, walks in a fur coat at the bottom of the mine with a torch in his hand and burns the gas (firedamp); (2) the name of the cruel mining master Shubin, who slew workers underground; (3) the sound from methane (Shu-Shu), which often accumulates in the mines.

statement.id: Penjelasan nama: (1) julukan penambang yang arwahnya berjalan di dasar tambang bermantel bulu membawa obor dan membakar gas tambang; (2) nama mandor kejam Shubin yang membunuh pekerja di bawah tanah; (3) bunyi metana "shu-shu".
statement.en: Explanations of the name: (1) the nickname of a miner whose soul walks the mine bottom in a fur coat with a torch, burning firedamp; (2) the cruel mine boss Shubin who killed workers underground; (3) the "shu-shu" sound of methane.

basis_claims.quote: Изустное предание гласит о добром Шубине, предупреждающим шахтёров о грядущих бедах. Образ Шубина представляется мужчиной средних лет с кашлем курильщика."Слышишь кашель-делай ноги!".

statement.id: Tuturan lisan menyebut Shubin yang baik memperingatkan penambang akan bencana; ia dibayangkan sebagai lelaki paruh baya dengan batuk perokok: "Dengar batuk, segera lari!"
statement.en: Oral lore tells of good Shubin warning miners of coming disasters; he is imagined as a middle-aged man with a smoker's cough: "Hear the cough, run!"

statement.en: Zhytsen walks the fields making sure the crops are well reaped; Belarusian folklore holds that if it finds ears of grain left behind, it binds them into sheaves and carries them to the fields of more diligent farmers.

basis_claims.quote: boginki (singular: boginka) are female spirits or demons of wild nature: forest, field, mountains, or water (both of land and sea) and is often a personification of the forces of nature. The word literally means "minor goddess" in Polish and may be translated as "fairy" or "nymph". They were usually imagined as either ugly old hags or pretty young girls, usually naked. They are usually evil.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi pagan Polandia, boginki (tunggal boginka) adalah roh atau iblis perempuan alam liar (hutan, ladang, gunung, perairan), sering perwujudan kekuatan alam; kata ini berarti "dewi kecil" dan dapat diterjemahkan peri atau nimfa; mereka dibayangkan sebagai nenek buruk rupa atau gadis cantik, biasanya telanjang, dan umumnya jahat.
statement.en: In Polish pagan mythology boginki (singular boginka) are female spirits or demons of wild nature (forest, field, mountains, water), often personifying natural forces; the word means "minor goddess" and may be translated "fairy" or "nymph"; imagined as ugly hags or pretty girls, usually naked, and usually evil.

basis_claims.quote: В поверьях Оравы, Спиша и особенно Замагурья богинка описывается как злое уродливое существо c высокой нескладной фигурой, непропорционально большой головой, вздутым животом, кривыми ногами, чёрными зубами, большими грудями, которые закидывались назад через плечо. Также богинки могут появляться в виде животных — кошек, собак, лягушек и др.

statement.id: Dalam kepercayaan di Orava dan Spiš, boginka adalah makhluk jahat buruk rupa bertubuh tinggi canggung, berkepala besar, berperut buncit, berkaki bengkok, bergigi hitam, dan berpayudara besar yang disampirkan ke belakang bahu; boginki juga dapat muncul sebagai kucing, anjing, atau katak.
statement.en: In Orava and Spiš belief the boginka is an evil, ugly being, tall and gawky, with an oversized head, swollen belly, crooked legs, black teeth and large breasts thrown back over the shoulder; boginki can also appear as cats, dogs or frogs.

basis_claims.quote: Boginki zamieszkiwały bagna, jeziora, rzeki, lasy i góry. Można je było spotkać nad wodą podczas prania chust drewnianymi kijankami. ... Boginkami miały stawać się kobiety zmarłe przy porodzie, samobójczynie i morderczynie dzieci.

statement.id: Perempuan yang mati saat melahirkan, bunuh diri, atau membunuh anaknya dipercaya menjadi boginka; boginki tinggal di rawa, danau, sungai, hutan, dan gunung, dan dijumpai di tepi air saat mencuci kain.
statement.en: Women who died in childbirth, suicides and child-murderers were said to become boginki; they lived in marshes, lakes, rivers, forests and mountains and were met by the water washing cloths.

basis_claims.quote: L'origine d'Akbuzat est liée à la large diffusion du totémisme parmi les peuples turciques, ainsi qu'au culte du cheval, qui jouait un rôle important dans la vie des Turcs. La couleur blanche symbolise une naissance réussie et heureuse, une vie, une mort paisible et un enterrement digne.

statement.id: Asal-usul Akbuzat terkait luasnya totemisme di kalangan bangsa Turkik dan pemujaan kuda, sedangkan warna putih melambangkan kelahiran yang selamat, hidup bahagia, kematian damai, dan pemakaman yang layak.
statement.en: Akbuzat's origin is tied to widespread totemism among Turkic peoples and the cult of the horse, while white symbolises a safe birth, a happy life, a peaceful death and a worthy burial.

basis_claims.quote: Dans la mythologie bachkire, c'est un cheval héroïque ailé magique, ancêtre des Tulpars. Cheval d'Oural-Batyr, personnage principal de l'épopée bachkire (kubair) « Akbuzat ».

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Bashkir ia kuda pahlawan bersayap yang ajaib, leluhur para tulpar, kuda Ural-Batyr, dan tokoh utama epos Bashkir (kubair) Akbuzat.
statement.en: In Bashkir mythology it is a magic winged heroic horse, ancestor of the tulpars, Ural-Batyr's horse and the title character of the Bashkir epic (kubair) Akbuzat.

basis_claims.quote: Күктә тыуған, ерҙә һәм һыу аҫтында йәшәй ала, утта янмай, һыуҙа батмай, тояҡтары менән тауҙарҙы емерә һәм диңгеҙҙе айыра.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Bashkir, ia lahir di langit, dapat hidup di darat dan di bawah air, tidak terbakar api, tidak tenggelam, menghancurkan gunung dengan kukunya, dan membelah laut.
statement.en: According to the Bashkir article, it was born in the sky, can live on land and under water, does not burn in fire or sink in water, smashes mountains with its hooves and parts the sea.

badrac.depicted_variant: Seven-headed scaled dragon with a whip tail and restrained documented fire breath.
visual_requirements: Exactly seven separately visible heads on a single dragon body
Armour-like scales and one long whip tail
Restrained fire from one mouth only; no generic aura
badrac.aura: Threatening presence through an alert fan of seven heads, armoured material and storm-dark natural light.

basis_claims.quote: Badraç, Türk mitolojisinde Yedibaşlı Ejderha; Padraç da denir. Yedi tane başı vardır. Ölmesi için yedisinin de kesilmesi gerekir.

statement.id: Badraç adalah Naga Berkepala Tujuh (Yedibaşlı Ejderha) dalam mitologi Turk, juga disebut Padraç; ia punya tujuh kepala, dan untuk mati ketujuhnya harus dipenggal.
statement.en: Badraç is the Seven-Headed Dragon (Yedibaşlı Ejderha) of Turkic (Türk) mythology, also called Padraç; it has seven heads, and all seven must be cut off for it to die.

basis_claims.quote: Ağzından ateşler saçar. Kuyruğu bir kamçı gibi şaklar. Derisi zırh gibi pullarla kaplıdır.

statement.id: Ia menyemburkan api (ateş) dari mulutnya, ekornya melecut seperti cambuk (kamçı), dan kulitnya tertutup sisik seperti baju zirah (zırh).
statement.en: It spews fire (ateş) from its mouth, its tail cracks like a whip (kamçı), and its skin is covered in scales like armour (zırh).

feathered-serpent.depicted_variant: Olmec crested rattlesnake Feathered Serpent, selecting legless feathered variant
visual_requirements: One coiling legless serpent with rattlesnake head and visible tail rattle
Layered feather crest and feathered portions of body
No bird wings, human form or generic magical effects
feathered-serpent.aura: Calm sacred authority through upright head, close framing and natural forest dawn light

basis_claims.quote: The Feathered Serpent is a prominent supernatural entity or deity found in many Mesoamerican religions.

statement.id: Ular Berbulu adalah sosok supernatural atau dewa penting dalam banyak agama Mesoamerika.
statement.en: The Feathered Serpent is a prominent supernatural entity or deity in many Mesoamerican religions.

basis_claims.quote: being feathered represents its divine nature or ability to fly to reach the skies, while being a serpent represents its human nature or ability to creep on the ground

statement.id: Bulu melambangkan sifat ilahinya atau kemampuan terbang ke langit, sedangkan wujud ular melambangkan sifat manusiawi atau kemampuan melata di tanah.
statement.en: Its feathers represent its divine nature or ability to fly to the skies, while its serpent form represents its human nature or ability to creep on the ground.

basis_claims.quote: Representations of feathered serpents appear in the Olmec culture (c. 1400–400 BC).

statement.id: Penggambaran ular berbulu sudah muncul dalam kebudayaan Olmek (sekitar 1400–400 SM).
statement.en: Representations of feathered serpents appear in Olmec culture (c. 1400–400 BC).

basis_claims.quote: show the Feathered Serpent as a crested rattlesnake, sometimes with feathers covering the body and legs, and often close to humans.

statement.id: Seni Olmek menggambarkannya sebagai ular derik berjambul, kadang dengan bulu menutupi tubuh dan kaki, dan sering berada dekat manusia.
statement.en: Olmec art shows it as a crested rattlesnake, sometimes with feathers covering the body and legs, often close to humans.

rodos-jdahas.depicted_variant: Bosio's medium-horse-size Rhodes dragon, portrait of documented serpent head and scaled mule ears
visual_requirements: Scaled reptilian serpent head and two long mule-shaped ears
Hard scales and visibly sharp teeth
Close head/neck portrait leaves undescribed limbs and tail outside frame
No inflated gigantic scale
rodos-jdahas.aura: Threatening alert expression, dark scales and naturally lit rocky Mediterranean dusk

basis_claims.quote: Le dragon de l'île de Rhodes est un animal mythique qui, d'après la légende, semait la terreur dans la « vallée de Soudourli », au pied du mont Saint-Étienne (« Agios Stephanos », actuellement « Monte Smith »).

statement.id: Naga pulau Rhodes adalah hewan mitos yang menurut legenda meneror "lembah Soudourli" di kaki gunung Santo Stefanus (Agios Stephanos, kini Monte Smith).
statement.en: The dragon of Rhodes is a mythical animal that, according to legend, terrorised the 'Soudourli valley' at the foot of Mount Saint Stephen (Agios Stephanos, now Monte Smith).

basis_claims.quote: le Dragon estoit de la grosseur d'un cheval moyen, la teste de serpent, les oreilles de mulet couvertes de peau fort dure et escailles, les dents fort aigus

statement.id: Menurut legenda Bosio, naga itu sebesar kuda sedang, berkepala ular, bertelinga bagal yang berkulit sangat keras dan bersisik, dan bergigi sangat tajam.
statement.en: In Bosio's legend the dragon was the size of a medium horse, with a serpent's head, mule's ears covered in very hard, scaly skin, and very sharp teeth.

basis_claims.quote: Rodos əjdahası — əfsanəyə görə 1340-cı illərdə, səlibçilərin hökmranlığı dövründə, Rodos adasının əhalisinə divan tutan və Müqəddəs Stefan dağının (Monte Smit) ətəyində yaşayan kiçik ölçülərə malik əjdaha.

statement.id: Artikel bahasa Azerbaijan menyebutnya naga kecil yang pada 1340-an, masa kekuasaan tentara salib, meneror penduduk Rhodes dari kaki gunung Santo Stefanus.
statement.en: The Azerbaijani article calls it a small dragon that in the 1340s, under crusader rule, terrorised the people of Rhodes from the foot of Mount Saint Stephen.

zaldi.depicted_variant: Zamari zuria, the headless white horse haunting Basque mountains, shown intact and bloodless as a supernatural form.
visual_requirements: One white equine body with four legs
Truly headless: no equine head or face, clean smooth natural end to neck
Mountain setting without wings or glowing effects
zaldi.aura: The unsettling headless form, solitary mountain silhouette and natural dusk create ominous presence.

basis_claims.quote: Zamari zuria, est un cheval blanc, un cheval sans tête qui hante les montagnes basques ... Le voir est un présage de mort ou, tout au moins, de malheur imminent.

statement.id: Zamari zuria adalah kuda putih tanpa kepala yang menghantui pegunungan Basque; melihatnya pertanda kematian atau setidaknya kemalangan yang segera datang.
statement.en: Zamari zuria is a white, headless horse haunting the Basque mountains; seeing it portends death or at least imminent misfortune.

basis_claims.quote: En los monts de Sola y Ultrapuertos cuan amaneix lo caballo sin capeza gosa estar un anuncio de la muerte.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Aragon, di pegunungan Sola dan Ultrapuertos kemunculan kuda tanpa kepala biasanya menandakan kematian.
statement.en: According to the Aragonese article, in the mountains of Sola and Ultrapuertos the appearance of the headless horse usually heralds death.

chudo-yudo.depicted_variant: Six-headed serpent of Ivan the Peasant's Son and Chudo-Yudo; no twelve-headed fiery-finger or Fish-Whale mixture.
visual_requirements: Exactly six separate heads and necks on one snake body
No limbs, wings, horns or twelve-headed variant attributes
Stony riverbank crossing setting
chudo-yudo.aura: Ominous presence from six poised serpent heads, predatory gaze and bleak natural riverside light.

basis_claims.quote: В русской народной сказке «Иван — крестьянский сын и Чудо-юдо» Чудо-юдо — это группа многоголовых (6-, 9-, 12-головых) змеев, отрицательных персонажей. Живут они за рекой Смородиной, через которую перебираются по Калинову мосту. В сказке Чудо-юдо изображается верхом на коне. Вред от него заключается в том, что оно сжигает города-сёла огнём.

statement.id: Dalam dongeng "Ivan, Anak Petani, dan Chudo-Yudo", Chudo-Yudo adalah sekelompok ular berkepala 6, 9, dan 12 (enam, sembilan, dua belas) yang jahat, tinggal di seberang Sungai Smorodina dan menyeberang lewat Jembatan Kalinov, digambarkan menunggang kuda, dan membakar kota serta desa.
statement.en: In the tale "Ivan the Peasant's Son and Chudo-Yudo", Chudo-Yudo is a group of evil 6-, 9- and 12-headed serpents living beyond the River Smorodina, crossing by the Kalinov Bridge, shown on horseback, burning towns and villages.

faronika.depicted_variant: Single fish-shaped Faronika carrying the earth on its back
visual_requirements: One immense coherent fish, normal fins and tail
Earth with mountains and forests above its broad back
No two-fish tradition or merged Veronika woman-serpent variant
faronika.aura: Cosmic scale and sacred quiet tension conveyed by dark sea depths, low dawn and tiny forest reference features

basis_claims.quote: Faronika je ryba či vodní had ze slovinského folklóru, která na svých zádech nese zemi. Její pohyb způsobuje zemětřesení a když se potopí nastane konec světa.

statement.id: Faronika adalah ikan atau ular air dalam cerita rakyat Slovenia yang memikul bumi di punggungnya; geraknya menyebabkan gempa, dan bila ia menyelam dunia berakhir.
statement.en: Faronika is a fish or water serpent of Slovene folklore that carries the earth on its back; its movement causes earthquakes, and when it dives the world ends.

basis_claims.quote: Faronika je lik iz slovenske mitologije. Je bitje v obliki ribe, ki na hrbtu nosi svet.

statement.id: Faronika adalah tokoh mitologi Slovenia, makhluk berbentuk ikan yang memikul dunia di punggungnya.
statement.en: Faronika is a figure of Slovene mythology, a fish-shaped being that carries the world on its back.

basis_claims.quote: Riba Faronika, naj bi, kot mitološko bitje, nastopala v s krščanstvom povezani staroslovanski zgodbi o nastanku sveta, v katerem so sprva obstajali le Bog, Sonce in morje.

statement.id: Ikan Faronika, sebagai makhluk mitologis, konon muncul dalam kisah Slavia lama terkait Kekristenan tentang penciptaan dunia, ketika yang ada hanyalah Tuhan, Matahari, dan laut.
statement.en: The fish Faronika, as a mythological being, is said to appear in an Old Slavic, Christian-linked story of the creation of the world, in which at first only God, the Sun and the sea existed.

kuperan.depicted_variant: Siegfried-cycle human-looking giant Kuperan with mountain key
visual_requirements: One human-looking giant with normal human anatomy
Visible iron key at mountain entrance
Giant scale indicated by small trees and low framing
No invented horns, animal limbs or magic effects
kuperan.aura: Threatening treacherous gaze, looming stance and rock shadows under cold twilight

basis_claims.quote: Kuperan ist in dem Sagenkreis um Siegfried den Drachentöter ein Riese, der den Zugangsschlüssel zu einem Berg hat, wo ein Drache haust.

statement.id: Kuperan adalah raksasa (Riese) dalam kisah Siegfried pembunuh naga (Drachentöter), pemegang kunci (Zugangsschlüssel) gunung (Berg) tempat naga (Drache) tinggal.
statement.en: Kuperan is a giant (Riese) in the Siegfried dragon-slayer (Drachentöter) cycle, holding the key (Zugangsschlüssel) to a mountain (Berg) where a dragon (Drache) lives.

basis_claims.quote: Er verrät Siegfried, der die Jungfrau Kriemhilde von dem Felsen retten will, zweimal und wird am Ende von Siegfried vom Felsen gestoßen, wo er in tausend Stücke zerspringt.

statement.id: Ia mengkhianati (verrät) Siegfried dua kali (zweimal) ketika Siegfried hendak menyelamatkan Kriemhilde, dan akhirnya didorong dari batu karang (Felsen) hingga pecah seribu keping (tausend Stücke).
statement.en: He betrays (verrät) Siegfried twice (zweimal) as Siegfried seeks to rescue Kriemhilde, and is finally pushed off the rock (Felsen), shattering into a thousand pieces (tausend Stücke).

basis_claims.quote: Eugel tells him that the giant Kuperan lives nearby, who has the key to the mountain. Kuperan and Seyfrid fight, but Seyfrid wounds the giant, whom he spares in exchange for help freeing Kriemhild. Yet while they are riding through the forest, Kuperan attacks Seyfrid, knocking him unconscious.

statement.id: Eugel berkata raksasa Kuperan tinggal di dekat situ dan memegang kunci gunung; Seyfrid melukai dan mengampuninya demi bantuan membebaskan Kriemhild, tetapi di hutan Kuperan menyerang Seyfrid hingga pingsan.
statement.en: Eugel says the giant Kuperan lives nearby and has the key to the mountain; Seyfrid wounds and spares him for help freeing Kriemhild, but in the forest Kuperan knocks Seyfrid unconscious.

basis_claims.quote: But by a stroke of luck, the treacherous giant Kuperan tells him that nearby there is stored a mighty sword, the only one which is capable of defeating the dragon. Kuperan then attacks Seyfrid disloyally for the third time after crying mercy

statement.id: Kuperan memberi tahu letak pedang yang mampu mengalahkan naga, lalu menyerang Seyfrid untuk ketiga kalinya.
statement.en: Kuperan tells of a sword able to defeat the dragon, then attacks Seyfrid disloyally for the third time.

heqet.depicted_variant: One majestic Egyptian fertility goddess in FROG-HEADED WOMAN variant: a single anatomically accurate frog head with rounded bulging frog eyes and ordinary human body, two arms and two legs, fully modest ceremonial dress. Standing benevolently above a vast rising Nile flood with small green cultivated riverbanks; soft visible breath-like mist near her mouth hints at breathing LIFE, not an attack or fabricated ray. Low-angle monumental composition, dramatic golden dawn over floodwater. No crocodile head, no extra arms, no invented horns or eggs.

visual_requirements.description: One majestic Egyptian fertility goddess in FROG-HEADED WOMAN variant: a single anatomically accurate frog head with rounded bulging frog eyes and ordinary human body, two arms and two legs, fully modest ceremonial dress. Standing benevolently above a vast rising Nile flood with small green cultivated riverbanks; soft visible breath-like mist near her mouth hints at breathing LIFE, not an attack or fabricated ray. Low-angle monumental composition, dramatic golden dawn over floodwater. No crocodile head, no extra arms, no invented horns or eggs.
Nile flood and soft breath-of-life mist; basis: documented flood fertility association and life-giving breath

heqet.aura: Nile flood and soft breath-of-life mist

basis_claims.quote: Heqet (Egyptian ḥqt, also ḥqtyt "Heqtit"), sometimes spelled Heket, is an Egyptian goddess of fertility, identified with Hathor, represented in the form of a frog.

statement.id: Heqet adalah dewi kesuburan Mesir yang digambarkan sebagai katak.
statement.en: Heqet is an Egyptian fertility goddess depicted as a frog.

basis_claims.quote:
To the Egyptians, the frog was an ancient symbol of fertility, related to the annual flooding of the Nile. 
Heqet was originally the female counterpart of Khnum, or the wife of Khnum, and eventually she also became the mother of Heru-ur.
It has been proposed that her name is the origin of the name of Hecate, the Greek goddess of witchcraft.

statement.id: Katak berkaitan dengan banjir tahunan Nil dan kesuburan.
statement.en: The frog is linked with the annual Nile flood and fertility.

basis_claims.quote: In the Osiris myth, it was Heqet who breathed life into the new body of Horus at birth, as she was a goddess of the last moments of birth. As the birth of Horus became more intimately associated with the resurrection of Osiris, so Heqet's role became one more closely associated with resurrection.

statement.id: Dalam mitos Osiris ia memberikan napas hidup kepada Horus saat lahir.
statement.en: In the Osiris myth she breathes life into Horus at birth.

basis_claims.quote: Heqet (Heket) - Goddess of fertility and childbirth, depicted as a frog or a woman with the head of a frog.

statement.id: Sumber pendamping menggambarkannya sebagai katak atau perempuan berkepala katak.
statement.en: The accompanying source depicts her as a frog or frog-headed woman.

artistic_changes: Low-angle framing, painterly materials and environmental color are artistic rendering.
Effects are limited to the cited domains, deeds, attributes or iconography; natural light and scale supply presence where no elemental ability is documented.

presentation_revision.rationale: Big names (major gods, archangels, demon princes, primordial monsters, famous literary beings) must look imposing and powerful: an epic, awe-inspiring or terrifying presence that matches their standing in the tradition.

taweret.depicted_variant: One benevolent Egyptian protection goddess, BIPEDAL female HIPPOPOTAMUS with lion-like paws and crocodilian back/tail features; upright coherent hippopotamus head, two front limbs and two standing rear legs. Modest draped ceremonial cloth fully covers torso; maternal strong protective expression. Low-angle commanding stance beside tiny household protection amulets in ancient Egyptian sanctuary, warm dramatic morning light. Remain majestic rather than evil monster. No glowing forcefield, energy or fabricated supernatural anatomy.

visual_requirements.description: One benevolent Egyptian protection goddess, BIPEDAL female HIPPOPOTAMUS with lion-like paws and crocodilian back/tail features; upright coherent hippopotamus head, two front limbs and two standing rear legs. Modest draped ceremonial cloth fully covers torso; maternal strong protective expression. Low-angle commanding stance beside tiny household protection amulets in ancient Egyptian sanctuary, warm dramatic morning light. Remain majestic rather than evil monster. No glowing forcefield, energy or fabricated supernatural anatomy.
Warm natural sanctuary radiance; basis: protective fertility and childbirth role; no specified elemental power

basis_claims.quote: is the protective goddess of childbirth and fertility.

statement.id: Taweret adalah dewi Mesir pelindung kelahiran dan kesuburan.
statement.en: Taweret is an Egyptian goddess protecting childbirth and fertility.

basis_claims.quote: The name "Taweret" means "she who is great" or simply "great one"

statement.id: Namanya berarti Yang Agung.
statement.en: Her name means the Great One.

basis_claims.quote: The deity is typically depicted as a bipedal female hippopotamus with feline attributes, pendulous female human breasts, the limbs and paws of a lion, and the back and tail of a Nile crocodile.

statement.id: Ia berupa kuda nil betina berkaki dua dengan unsur singa dan buaya.
statement.en: She takes the form of a bipedal female hippopotamus with lion and crocodile features.

basis_claims.quote: It was not until the Middle Kingdom of Egypt (c. 2055–1650 BCE) that Taweret became featured more prominently as a figure of religious devotion. Her image adorns magical objects, the most notable of which being a common type of "wand" or "knife" carved from hippopotamus ivory that was likely used in rituals associated with birth and the protection of infants.

statement.id: Gambarnya menghiasi pisau atau tongkat magis untuk ritual perlindungan bayi.
statement.en: Her image adorns magical knives or wands used in infant-protection rites.

artistic_changes: Low-angle framing, painterly materials and environmental color are artistic rendering.
Effects are limited to the cited domains, deeds, attributes or iconography; natural light and scale supply presence where no elemental ability is documented.

presentation_revision.rationale: Big names (major gods, archangels, demon princes, primordial monsters, famous literary beings) must look imposing and powerful: an epic, awe-inspiring or terrifying presence that matches their standing in the tradition.

leucrota.depicted_variant: Pliny's ass-sized leucrocotta: stag haunches, lion breast/neck/tail, badger head, cloven hooves and continuous bone ridges replacing teeth.
visual_requirements: Stag haunches with cloven hooves and lion neck/breast/tail
Badger head and continuous bone ridges instead of teeth
No horns, giant scale or mixing boar-haunch variant
leucrota.aura: Uncanny presence from wide-eyed badger head, open bonelike cutting jaw, stiff neck and dusk lighting.

basis_claims.quote: Pliny (VIII.72–73) also writes of another hyena-like creature, the leucrocotta, which he calls "the swiftest of all beasts, about the size of an ass, with a stag's haunches, a lion's neck, tail and breast, badger's head, cloven hoof, mouth opening right back to the ears, and ridges of bone in place of rows of teeth—this animal is reported to imitate the voices of human beings."

statement.id: Pliny menulis tentang leucrocotta mirip hiena, hewan tercepat sebesar keledai, berpaha rusa, berkepala luak, bertulang ganti gigi, yang meniru suara manusia.
statement.en: Pliny writes of the hyena-like leucrocotta, the swiftest beast, ass-sized, with stag's haunches, badger's head, bone ridges for teeth, said to imitate human voices.

basis_claims.quote: Later bestiaries of the Middle Ages confounded these various accounts, so that one finds the largely mythical creature given differing names and various characteristics, real and imaginary.

statement.id: Bestiari Abad Pertengahan (Middle Ages) kemudian mencampuradukkan berbagai kisah ini, sehingga makhluk itu diberi nama dan ciri yang berbeda-beda.
statement.en: Later bestiaries of the Middle Ages confounded these accounts, giving the creature differing names and characteristics.

gizotso.depicted_variant: The night woodland half-man, half-wolf monster laden with chains; not the alternative human Monsieur La Forêt.
visual_requirements: Half-human half-wolf physical hybrid
Visible iron chains
Forest-edge night scene without victims or gore
gizotso.aura: Threatening gaze, hunched poised figure and natural moonlit forest shadows convey horror presence.

basis_claims.quote: C'est un être considéré comme un monstre, moitié-homme et moitié-loup. Il habite les alentours des bois et il apparaît parfois la nuit, chargés de chaînes.

statement.id: Ia dianggap monster setengah manusia setengah serigala yang tinggal di sekitar hutan dan kadang muncul pada malam hari dengan membawa rantai.
statement.en: It is considered a monster, half man and half wolf, living around the woods and sometimes appearing at night laden with chains.

basis_claims.quote: On raconte qu'un Gizotso habite dans l'obscurité du village pyrénéen de Luzaide, on imagine qu'il possède une force surhumaine.

statement.id: Konon seorang Gizotso tinggal dalam kegelapan desa Pyrenees Luzaide dan memiliki kekuatan luar biasa.
statement.en: A Gizotso is said to dwell in the darkness of the Pyrenean village of Luzaide, with superhuman strength.

hobangoas.depicted_variant: Three-legged billy-goat Habergeiß with horse hooves, long beard and restrained glowing eyes; excludes feathered/bird and procession variants.
visual_requirements: Exactly three goat legs ending in solid horse hooves
Long billy-goat beard and two glowing eyes
Goat variant without bird-body mixture or generic aura
hobangoas.aura: Sinister presence through fixed gaze, long beard, shadowed shaggy coat and cold Alpine dusk; only the source-supported eyes glow.

basis_claims.quote: Die Habergeiß (bair. Habergoaß) ist eine Dämonengestalt in Form einer Ziege mit Pferdehufen oder eines Vogels, der entweder die Stimme einer Ziege hat oder in einer anderen Weise verunstaltet ist.

statement.id: Habergeiß (Bayern: Habergoaß) adalah sosok setan berwujud kambing berkuku kuda atau burung yang bersuara kambing atau cacat dengan cara lain.
statement.en: The Habergeiß (Bavarian dialect of Bavaria: Habergoaß) is a demon figure shaped like a goat with horse's hooves or a bird that has a goat's voice or is otherwise deformed.

basis_claims.quote: In der Volkssage wird die Habergeiß meist als dreibeiniger Geißbock mit glühenden Augen und langem Bart beschrieben. In einigen Sagen besitzt dieser Geißbock kein Fell, sondern ein Gefieder. Die Habergeiß zu sehen gilt als böses Omen. Laut einer alten Sage ist die Habergeiß das Haustier der Perchten und übertrifft sie in der Stärke überragend.

statement.id: Dalam legenda rakyat Habergeiß biasanya kambing jantan berkaki tiga bermata menyala dan berjanggut panjang, kadang berbulu burung; melihatnya pertanda buruk; menurut legenda lama ia hewan peliharaan para Perchten dan jauh lebih kuat dari mereka.
statement.en: In folk legend the Habergeiß is mostly a three-legged billy goat with glowing eyes and a long beard, sometimes feathered; seeing it is an evil omen; an old legend makes it the Perchten's pet, far surpassing them in strength.

tikbalang.depicted_variant: Common later horse-headed and horse-hoofed tall bony humanoid, with disproportionately long limbs; earlier winged variant is not combined.
visual_requirements: Horse head and hooves on tall thin humanoid body
Two arms/two legs, conspicuously elongated limbs
Philippine rainforest without wings, armor or invented magic
tikbalang.aura: Uncanny lanky silhouette, sideways alert gaze and natural forest lighting express mischievous supernatural presence.

basis_claims.quote: is a creature of Philippine folklore said to lurk in the mountains and rainforests of the Philippines. It is a tall, bony humanoid creature with the head and hooves of a horse and disproportionately long limbs, to the point that its knees reach above its head when it squats down. In some versions, it is a transformation of an aborted fetus sent to earth from limbo.

statement.id: Tikbalang (juga Tigbalang, Tigbalan, Tikbalan, Tigbolan) adalah makhluk cerita rakyat Filipina yang mengintai di pegunungan dan hutan hujan; tinggi, kurus, berkepala dan berkuku kuda, bertungkai sangat panjang hingga lututnya melewati kepala saat berjongkok; dalam beberapa versi ia jelmaan janin yang digugurkan dan dikirim dari limbo.
statement.en: The tikbalang (also Tigbalang, Tigbalan, Tikbalan, Tigbolan) is a Philippine folklore creature lurking in mountains and rainforests; tall, bony, with a horse's head and hooves and limbs so long its knees pass its head when squatting; in some versions it is an aborted fetus sent from limbo.

basis_claims.quote: Tikbalang is generally associated with dark, sparsely populated, foliage-overgrown areas, with legends variously identifying their habitat as being beneath bridges, in bamboo clumps or banana groves, and atop Kalumpang (Sterculia foetida) or Balite (Ficus indica) trees.

statement.id: Tikbalang dikaitkan dengan tempat gelap, sepi, dan rimbun, seperti di bawah jembatan, rumpun bambu, kebun pisang, atau di atas pohon kalumpang dan balete.
statement.en: The tikbalang is linked with dark, lonely, overgrown places such as under bridges, bamboo clumps, banana groves, or atop kalumpang and balete trees.

basis_claims.quote: Tikbalangs or Tigbolan scare travelers, lead them astray and play tricks on them such as making them return to an arbitrary path no matter how far they go or turn. Wearing one’s shirt inside out is believed to counteract this. Another countermeasure is to ask permission aloud to pass by

statement.id: Tikbalang menakuti dan menyesatkan pejalan, membuat mereka kembali ke jalan yang sama; memakai baju terbalik atau meminta izin lewat dengan keras dipercaya menangkalnya.
statement.en: Tikbalangs scare and mislead travellers, making them return to the same path; wearing a shirt inside out or asking permission aloud is believed to counter this.

b-khesten.depicted_variant: White brook horse with sharp fangs and a lengthening back carrying multiple children
visual_requirements: White brook horse with sharp fangs and a lengthening back carrying multiple children
Coherent anatomy and documented mythic scene
b-khesten.aura: Presence through source-backed form and physical scene; no generic glow, ribbons or magical mist.

basis_claims.quote: Bäckahästen (schwedisch, von bäck „Bach“ und hästen „das Pferd“) ist im schonischen Volksglauben der Geist eines Baches oder der Näck in Pferdegestalt. Es kann mit den Wasserpferden aus der keltischen Mythologie wie dem schottischen Each Uisge, dem schottisch-irischen Kelpie oder dem walisischen Ceffyl dŵr verglichen werden.

statement.id: Bäckahästen (Swedia: bäck, "sungai kecil", dan hästen, "kuda") dalam kepercayaan rakyat Skåne adalah roh sungai atau Näck dalam wujud kuda, yang dapat dibandingkan dengan kuda air mitologi Kelt seperti each uisge Skotlandia, kelpie, dan ceffyl dŵr Wales.
statement.en: Bäckahästen (Swedish bäck 'brook' and hästen 'the horse') is in Scanian folk belief a brook spirit or the Näck in horse form, comparable with Celtic water horses such as the Scottish each uisge, the kelpie and the Welsh ceffyl dŵr.

basis_claims.quote: Das Bäckahäst ist ein hinterhältiges Raubtier, das an Bächen, Flüssen und Seen lauert, wo es Reiter und andere Pferde ins Wasser zieht, um sie zu ertränken. Es zeigt sich als stattlicher Hengst, meist weiß schimmernd, aber sein Fell kann auch apfelgrau, schwarz oder blau changieren. Sein Maul ist voller scharfer Fangzähne.

statement.id: Bäckahäst adalah pemangsa licik yang mengintai di sungai dan danau untuk menyeret penunggang dan kuda lain ke air dan menenggelamkannya; ia tampak sebagai kuda jantan gagah yang biasanya putih berkilau, kadang kelabu belang, hitam, atau kebiruan, dengan mulut penuh taring tajam.
statement.en: The bäckahäst is a treacherous predator lurking by brooks, rivers and lakes, dragging riders and other horses into the water to drown them; it appears as a fine stallion, usually shimmering white, sometimes dapple-grey, black or blue, its mouth full of sharp fangs.

basis_claims.quote: Die Anzahl der Kinder spielt dabei keine Rolle, da der Pferderücken immer länger wird, je mehr Kinder sich auf das Untier setzen. Wenn man ein Bäckahäst daran hindern will, Kinder zu ertränken, soll man ein Stück Stahl zwischen das Pferd und das Wasser werfen. ... Eine andere Möglichkeit, dem Untier zu entkommen, besteht darin, dass ein Kind das christliche Wort „Kreuz“ ausruft

statement.id: Jumlah anak tak jadi soal karena punggung kuda makin panjang semakin banyak anak yang naik; untuk mencegahnya menenggelamkan anak, orang melempar sepotong baja di antara kuda dan air, atau seorang anak menyerukan kata Kristen "salib".
statement.en: The number of children does not matter, as the horse's back grows longer the more climb on; to stop it drowning children, throw a piece of steel between horse and water, or a child may cry out the Christian word 'cross'.

basis_claims.quote: Le bäckahäst, bäckahästen ou bækhesten (littéralement « cheval des ruisseaux ») est un cheval fantastique issu du folklore scandinave, très proche du kelpie. Il s'agit d'un majestueux cheval blanc qui apparait près des rivières, en particulier par temps de brouillard. Celui qui monte sur son dos se trouve incapable d'en descendre.

statement.id: Bäckahäst, bäckahästen, atau bækhesten (harfiah "kuda sungai kecil") adalah kuda khayalan cerita rakyat Skandinavia yang sangat mirip kelpie: kuda putih megah yang muncul dekat sungai, terutama saat berkabut, dan siapa yang naik ke punggungnya tak bisa turun.
statement.en: The bäckahäst, bäckahästen or bækhesten ('brook horse') is a fantastic horse of Scandinavian folklore very close to the kelpie: a majestic white horse appearing near rivers, especially in fog, and whoever mounts it cannot get off.

artistic_changes: Painterly square composition
Clothing, weather and exact setting details are editorial unless identified in claims

presentation_revision.rationale: Replaces ordinary animal presentation with White brook horse with sharp fangs and a lengthening back carrying multiple children

Domestic protective context with kittens at her feet.

bastet.aura: Regal monumental protective presence; golden natural light, no invented spells.

basis_claims.quote: She protected the home from evil spirits and disease, especially diseases associated with women and children.

statement.en: Many bronze statuettes from the Late Period show her with a cat's head, sometimes holding a sistrum

Research documents protection but no visible emission; grandeur through pose scale and sunlight.

vellamo.depicted_variant: Documented mermaid depiction in a blue sea-moss dress, sitting on a shoreline rock combing her hair.
visual_requirements: Beautiful human upper body and exactly one fish tail
Blue sea-moss dress covers torso
Rock-seated hair-combing pose; no invented magical glow
vellamo.aura: Beneficent mysterious presence through calm expression, elegant posture, natural soft morning sea light.

basis_claims.quote: The Mistress of Water also had cows. She often helped poor people by sending them cattle. ... When the Mistress's cows were on the beach eating, she herself is sitting a bit further away on a rock, combing her hair.

statement.id: Nyonya Air memiliki sapi dan sering menolong orang miskin dengan mengirimi mereka ternak; saat sapinya makan di pantai, ia duduk agak jauh di atas batu sambil menyisir rambut.
statement.en: The Mistress of Water had cows and often helped poor people by sending them cattle; while her cows ate on the beach she sat a little way off on a rock combing her hair.

basis_claims.quote: Vellamo est décrite grande et belle, et porte une robe bleue faite de mousse de mer. Elle est parfois représentée avec une queue de poisson, comme une sirène

statement.id: Vellamo digambarkan tinggi dan cantik, mengenakan gaun biru dari lumut laut, dan kadang ditampilkan berekor ikan seperti putri duyung.
statement.en: Vellamo is described as tall and beautiful, wearing a blue dress of sea moss, and is sometimes shown with a fish tail like a mermaid.

basandere.depicted_variant: Humanlike hairy wild woman with very long hair combing with a golden comb by a cave mouth.
visual_requirements: Adult humanlike woman, very long hair, visible body hair on arms
Golden comb clearly held in her hand
Cave entrance, modest opaque robe, no horns or invented animal anatomy
basandere.aura: Watchful reserved expression, quiet combing pose and chiaroscuro at a cave entrance convey wild guardian presence.

basis_claims.quote: Basandere, Basaandere, Basa Andere, Basandere (prononcer « bachandéré ») désigne dans la mythologie basque une créature imaginaire, un jentil, femme de Basajaun. C'est une sorte de femme poilue et sauvage, vivant dans les Pyrénées basques, en particulier dans la forêt d'Iraty.

statement.id: Basandere atau Basa Andere dalam mitologi Basque adalah makhluk khayalan, seorang jentil, istri Basajaun, perempuan liar berbulu yang tinggal di Pyrenees Basque, terutama hutan Iraty.
statement.en: Basandere or Basa Andere in Basque mythology is an imaginary being, a jentil, the wife of Basajaun, a hairy wild woman living in the Basque Pyrenees, especially the forest of Iraty.

basis_claims.quote: Les Basandere, compagnes des Basajaunak, ont pour habitude de rester à proximité de l'entrée des cavernes, ou près des fontaines. Elles y passent des heures à peigner leur chevelure, tout en gardant un œil sur leurs vastes trésors. Le vol d'un peigne d'or, par un berger, est un thème de conte fréquent.

statement.id: Basandere, pasangan para Basajaun, biasa berada dekat mulut gua atau mata air, berjam-jam menyisir rambut sambil mengawasi harta mereka; pencurian sisir emas oleh gembala adalah tema dongeng yang sering muncul.
statement.en: The Basandere, companions of the Basajaunak, stay near cave mouths or springs, combing their hair for hours while watching over their great treasures; a shepherd stealing a golden comb is a common tale theme.

basis_claims.quote: Según la leyenda, a la entrada de la cueva situada en la cima del monte Mondarrain una basandere suele peinar su melena con un peine de oro.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Spanyol, di mulut gua di puncak Gunung Mondarrain seorang basandere biasa menyisir rambutnya dengan sisir emas.
statement.en: According to the Spanish article, at the mouth of the cave on the summit of Mount Mondarrain a basandere combs her hair with a golden comb.

basis_claims.quote: La Basandere ('senyora del bosc, senyora salvatge', del basc basa 'bosc, salvatge' i andere 'senyora') és un personatge de la mitologia basca amb forma humana, el cos cobert de pèl i una cabellera molt llarga.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Katalan, Basandere (dari basa, "hutan, liar", dan andere, "nyonya") berwujud manusia, bertubuh berbulu, dan berambut sangat panjang.
statement.en: According to the Catalan article, the Basandere (from basa, 'forest, wild', and andere, 'lady') is humanlike, with a hairy body and very long hair.

bukrek-and-sangal.depicted_variant: Paired giant wingless long-necked lizards Bükrek and Sangal facing each other in opposed curved fighting poses.
visual_requirements: Exactly two distinct dragon bodies, each with one head
Long-necked giant lizard forms, strong claws, no wings
Opposed curved fighting poses without drawn yin-yang icon
bukrek-and-sangal.aura: Opposing resolute and threatening presence through curved bodies, confronting jaws, muscular clawed limbs and stormy natural ocean light.

basis_claims.quote: Bükrek və Sanqal - türk və altay mifologiyasında bibirleriyle döyüşən iki əjdaha. Döyüşərkən, görünüşləri İn və Yan simvolunu xatırladır.

statement.id: Bükrek dan Sanqal adalah dua naga (əjdaha) yang saling bertarung dalam mitologi Turki (türk) dan Altai (altay); ketika bertarung, rupa mereka mengingatkan pada lambang Yin dan Yang (İn və Yan).
statement.en: Bükrek and Sanqal are two dragons (əjdaha) that fight each other in Turkic (türk) and Altai (altay) mythology; while fighting, their appearance recalls the Yin and Yang (İn və Yan) symbol.

basis_claims.quote: Kərtənkələ görünüşlüdür. Qanadları yoxdur, bu səbəblə uça bilməz. Bütün dənizləri bir-birinə bağlayan böyük dənizdə (okeanda) yaşayır.

statement.id: Bükrek berwujud seperti kadal, tidak bersayap sehingga tidak bisa terbang, dan tinggal di laut besar (samudra) yang menghubungkan semua laut.
statement.en: Bükrek looks like a lizard, has no wings and so cannot fly, and lives in the great sea (ocean) that connects all seas.

basis_claims.quote: Türk ve Altay mitolojisinde birbirleriyle çok vahşî ve acımasızca savaşan iki ejderha.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Turki (Türk) dan Altai (Altay), keduanya adalah dua naga (ejderha) yang saling bertarung dengan sangat buas dan kejam.
statement.en: In Turkic (Türk) and Altai (Altay) mythology they are two dragons (ejderha) that fight each other very savagely and mercilessly.

basis_claims.quote: Devasa iki kertenkeleye benzerler. Kanatları yoktur, bu nedenle uçamazlar, uzun boyunları ve çok güçlü pençeleri vardır.

statement.id: Keduanya menyerupai dua kadal raksasa, tidak bersayap sehingga tidak bisa terbang, berleher panjang, dan bercakar sangat kuat.
statement.en: They resemble two giant lizards, have no wings and so cannot fly, and have long necks and very strong claws.

basis_claims.quote: Bükrek, Dünyâ'nın sonundaki tüm denizlerin birbirine bağlandığı büyük okyanusta yaşar.

statement.id: Bükrek tinggal di samudra besar di ujung dunia, tempat semua laut saling bertemu.
statement.en: Bükrek lives in the great ocean at the end of the world where all the seas are joined together.

basis_claims.quote: BÜKREK ve SANGAL: İyi ve Kötü Ejderhalar. [ İKA: Bükrâk vâ Sangal ] Eşdeğer: BUKRAK ve SANKAL

statement.id: Bükrek dan Sangal adalah naga baik dan naga jahat; bentuk lain nama mereka adalah Bukrak dan Sankal.
statement.en: Bükrek and Sangal are the Good and Evil Dragons; equivalent forms of their names are Bukrak and Sankal.

death.depicted_variant: One colossal Grim Reaper: skeletal human figure inside fully covering weathered dark robes, one scythe raised diagonally, standing at a silent threshold in bleak moonlit landscape. Show clearly a skull face and coherent skeletal hands, two arms and two legs under robes. Gentle distant translucent silhouettes of departed souls walk toward the threshold, interpreted as the psychopomp role rather than invented attack or energy beams. No victims or violence. Frame skeletal figure imposing and terrifying through scale and moonlit fog.

death.aura: Departed soul silhouettes approaching afterlife threshold

basis_claims.quote: In more modern stories, a character known as the Grim Reaper (usually depicted as a berobed skeleton wielding a scythe) causes the victim's death by coming to collect that person's soul.

statement.id: Dalam kisah modern, sosok yang dikenal sebagai Grim Reaper digambarkan sebagai kerangka berjubah pembawa sabit pencabut jiwa.
statement.en: In more modern stories, the Grim Reaper is depicted as a berobed skeleton wielding a scythe to collect souls.

basis_claims.quote: Other beliefs hold that the spectre of death is only a psychopomp, a benevolent figure who serves to gently sever the last ties between the soul and the body, and to guide the deceased to the afterlife, without having any control over when or how the victim dies.

statement.id: Kepercayaan lain memandang kematian sebagai psychopomp yang memandu orang meninggal ke alam baka tanpa mengendalikan kapan atau bagaimana orang itu meninggal.
statement.en: Other beliefs hold that death is a psychopomp, guiding the deceased to the afterlife without controlling when or how they die.

basis_claims.quote: It is the name given to a creature, spirit or deity who escorts people to the afterlife.

statement.id: Psychopomp adalah sebutan bagi makhluk, roh, atau dewa yang mengawal manusia ke alam baka.
statement.en: It is the name given to a creature, spirit or deity who escorts people to the afterlife.

basis_claims.quote: Some stories believe that the Reaper has no control over when or how a person dies, and its only role is to sever the final ties between the soul and the body, guiding the deceased to the afterlife.

statement.id: Beberapa cerita memandang Reaper tidak berkuasa atas waktu kematian dan hanya bertugas memutus ikatan jiwa lalu membimbingnya ke alam baka.
statement.en: Some stories believe the Reaper has no control over when a person dies, only severing ties and guiding the deceased to the afterlife.

drudwyn.depicted_variant: Drudwyn the white young hound with red ears in the hunt of Twrch Trwyth, controlled by Mabon ap Modron. White red-eared hound dashes forward in the foreground on a taut leash held by a human young Welsh huntsman Mabon; ahead across a wooded track stands an enormous wild boar, intact and not injured. Hound and huntsman visibly cooperate in the mythic hunt. Four hound legs, one head and tail, naturally red ears; no aura or glowing eyes. Generic period clothing and wooded staging are editorial.

basis_claims.quote: Drudwyn hat rote Ohren und einen weißen Körper.

statement.id: Drudwyn bertelinga merah (rote Ohren) dan bertubuh putih (weißen Körper).
statement.en: Drudwyn has red ears (rote Ohren) and a white body (weißen Körper).

basis_claims.quote: Er war nur durch Mabon ap Modron zu kontrollieren und fing für ihn den wilden Eber Twrch Trwyth ... so dass Mabon ihm Kamm und Schere entreißen konnte.

statement.id: Ia hanya dapat dikendalikan oleh Mabon ap Modron dan menangkap babi hutan liar (wilden Eber) Twrch Trwyth untuknya, sehingga Mabon bisa merebut sisir dan gunting (Kamm und Schere) darinya.
statement.en: He could be controlled only by Mabon ap Modron and caught the wild boar (wilden Eber) Twrch Trwyth for him, so that Mabon could snatch the comb and scissors (Kamm und Schere) from it.

basis_claims.quote: Throughout the world there is not a huntsman who can hunt with this dog, except Mabon the son of Modron.

statement.id: Di seluruh dunia tidak ada pemburu yang bisa berburu dengan anjing ini kecuali Mabon putra Modron.
statement.en: Throughout the world there is not a huntsman who can hunt with this dog, except Mabon the son of Modron.

eog-llyn-llyw.depicted_variant: Eog Llyn Llyw, enormous oldest salmon, carries two fully clothed Welsh heroes on its shoulders through a river toward the looming prison walls where Mabon must be rescued. One gigantic coherent salmon with the two adult men sitting astride behind its head, body cuts water, prison distant on bank. Explicit extraordinary carrying role and heroic voyage, no legs or wings on fish, no glow. Medieval clothes and tower architecture editorial.

Coherent anatomy
No arbitrary aura
eog-llyn-llyw.aura: Presence through source-supported iconography, narrative action, posture, scale and natural scene light; no generic magical glow.

basis_claims.quote: Mae'n cynnig cludo Gwrhyr ac Eidoel ar ei ysgwyddau i weld drostynt eu hunain. Llwyddant i siarad â'r carcharor sydd neb llai na Mabon fab Modron.

statement.id: Ia menawarkan untuk membawa (cludo) Gwrhyr dan Eidoel di atas bahunya (ysgwyddau) agar mereka melihat sendiri; mereka berhasil berbicara dengan tahanan (carcharor), yang tak lain adalah Mabon fab Modron.
statement.en: It offers to carry (cludo) Gwrhyr and Eidoel on its shoulders (ysgwyddau) to see for themselves; they manage to speak with the prisoner (carcharor), who is none other than Mabon fab Modron.

basis_claims.quote: aiff Cei a Bedwyr ar hyd yr afon ar ysgwyddau Eog Llyn Llyw. Cyrhaeddent y tŵr ar lan yr afon ac mae Cei yn rhwygo'r muriau ac yn rhyddhau Mabon.

statement.id: Cei dan Bedwyr menyusuri sungai (afon) di atas bahu (ysgwyddau) Eog Llyn Llyw; mereka sampai ke menara di tepi sungai, dan Cei menjebol tembok (muriau) lalu membebaskan (rhyddhau) Mabon.
statement.en: Cei and Bedwyr go along the river (afon) on the shoulders (ysgwyddau) of Eog Llyn Llyw; they reach the tower on the river bank, and Cei tears down the walls (muriau) and frees (rhyddhau) Mabon.

basis_claims.quote: Kai and Bedwyr went upon the shoulders of the fish, whilst the warriors of Arthur attacked the castle.

statement.id: Kai dan Bedwyr naik ke atas bahu ikan (fish) itu, sementara para prajurit Arthur menyerang kastel.
statement.en: Kai and Bedwyr went upon the shoulders of the fish while Arthur's warriors attacked the castle.

basis_claims.quote: 羽犬（はいぬ）は、福岡県筑後市で語り伝えられている伝説上の犬である。この犬は背中に一対の翼を持ち、自在に飛び回って暴虐の限りを尽くしていた。羽犬は島津氏征討のために九州に遠征していた羽柴秀吉の軍勢をも手こずらせたが、秀吉軍は何とか退治に成功した。秀吉は羽犬の強さに感じ入り、「羽犬塚」という塚を築いてその亡骸を手厚く葬ったという。

statement.id: Hainu adalah anjing legenda bersayap dalam cerita Chikugo, Fukuoka.

basis_claims.quote: 羽犬（はいぬ）は、福岡県筑後市で語り伝えられている伝説上の犬である。この犬は背中に一対の翼を持ち、自在に飛び回って暴虐の限りを尽くしていた。羽犬は島津氏征討のために九州に遠征していた羽柴秀吉の軍勢をも手こずらせたが、秀吉軍は何とか退治に成功した。秀吉は羽犬の強さに感じ入り、「羽犬塚」という塚を築いてその亡骸を手厚く葬ったという。
