In benevolent aspects, he is depicted as an omniscient yogi who lives an ascetic life on Kailasa as well as a householder with his wife Parvati and his two children, Ganesha and Kartikeya. In his fierce aspects, he is often depicted slaying demons.

statement.id: Siwa memiliki aspek welas asih dan menakutkan: ia digambarkan sebagai yogi mahatahu yang bertapa di Kailasa dan kepala keluarga bersama Parwati serta anak-anaknya, Ganesha dan Kartikeya, dan dalam aspek garangnya membinasakan raksasa.
statement.en: Shiva has benevolent and fearsome aspects: an omniscient ascetic yogi on Kailasa and a householder with Parvati and their children Ganesha and Kartikeya, and in fierce aspects a slayer of demons.

basis_claims.quote: The iconographical attributes of Shiva are the serpent king Vasuki around his neck, the adorning crescent moon, the holy river Ganga flowing from his matted hair, the third eye on his forehead (the eye that turns everything in front of it into ashes when opened), the trishula or trident as his weapon, and the damaru. He is usually worshiped in the aniconic form of lingam.

statement.id: Ciri ikonografi Siwa antara lain raja ular Vasuki di lehernya, bulan sabit, Sungai Gangga yang mengalir dari rambut gimbalnya, mata ketiga di dahinya, trisula, dan damaru; ia biasanya dipuja dalam wujud lingga.
statement.en: Shiva's attributes include the serpent king Vasuki round his neck, the crescent moon, the Ganga flowing from his matted hair, the third eye, the trident and the damaru; he is usually worshipped as the lingam.

basis_claims.quote: The poison burned his throat and left a permanent blue scar, hence one of his many titles became Nilakantha or Blue Throat.

statement.id: Racun yang diminum Siwa membakar tenggorokannya dan meninggalkan bekas biru permanen, sehingga ia bergelar Nilakantha, Si Leher Biru.
statement.en: The poison Shiva drank burned his throat and left a permanent blue scar, so he became Nilakantha, Blue Throat.

basis_claims.quote: To cushion Ganga's fall to the earth, and prevent such a great river destroying civilisation, Shiva caught her in his hair topknot

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, untuk meredam jatuhnya Gangga ke bumi dan mencegah sungai sebesar itu menghancurkan peradaban, Siwa menangkapnya dalam sanggul rambutnya.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, to cushion Ganga's fall to earth and stop so great a river from destroying civilisation, Shiva caught her in his hair topknot.

basis_claims.quote: Angry at this disturbance to his meditation, the god struck the cows with fire from his third eye.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam kisah tentang sapi Surabhi, Siwa yang terganggu meditasinya menyambar sapi-sapi itu dengan api dari mata ketiganya.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in the story of Surabhi's cows, Shiva, angry at the disturbance to his meditation, struck the cows with fire from his third eye.

basis_claims.quote: Sometimes he also rides his white bull, carries a silver bow (Pinaka), holds an antelope, and wears a tiger or elephant skin, all symbolic of his famed prowess as a hunter.
basis_claims.locator: How is Shiva Represented in Art?

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Siwa kadang digambarkan menunggang banteng putihnya, membawa busur perak (Pinaka), memegang kijang, dan mengenakan kulit harimau atau gajah, semuanya lambang keahliannya sebagai pemburu.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Shiva is sometimes shown riding his white bull, carrying a silver bow (Pinaka), holding an antelope and wearing a tiger or elephant skin, all symbolic of his famed prowess as a hunter.

basis_claims.quote: that wielder of the Pinaka-that one who had his abode on the mountains (of Kailasa)—accompanied by Uma

statement.id: Dalam Mahabharata, Mahadewa disebut pemegang Pinaka yang tinggal di pegunungan (Kailasa) bersama Uma.
statement.en: In the Mahabharata, Mahadeva is described as the wielder of the Pinaka who had his abode on the mountains (of Kailasa), accompanied by Uma.

zhu-bajie.depicted_variant: Boar-faced stout Zhu Bajie with nine-toothed rake stirring wind, clouds and flying sand.

visual_requirements.description: ZHU BAJIE as living fierce half-man HALF-PIG monster from original Journey to the West. One dark stout humanoid, long PIG SNOUT, huge pig ears, bristly MANE behind head and wild-boar face (c36,c40), exactly two arms and two legs, modest historic Chinese pilgrim tunic and trousers, imposing rather than comic toy. Firmly grips a great IRON RAKE with exactly NINE DISTINCT TEETH arranged in a clearly countable row (c38), broadside readable tool. Swings the rake as wind whips natural dust and stones, storm clouds and mist accumulate behind him from documented wind/cloud/sand powers (c37). Low camera outside his mountain cave Fuling/Yunzhan (c34), figure fills frame, strong coherent anatomy, rich painterly fur and cloth, no modern game/movie/anime designs.

zhu-bajie.aura: Boar-faced stout Zhu Bajie with nine-toothed rake stirring wind, clouds and flying sand.

basis_claims.quote: 叫做福陵山。山中有一洞，叫做雲棧洞。洞裡原有個卵二姐，他見我有些武藝，招我做了家長，又喚做倒蹅門。

statement.id: Ia menyebut gunung itu Fuling (福陵山), dengan sebuah gua bernama Yunzhan (雲棧洞) di dalamnya; di gua itu dahulu ada Luan Erjie (卵二姐) yang, melihat ia punya kepandaian bela diri, mengangkatnya sebagai kepala keluarga.
statement.en: He names the mountain Fuling (福陵山), with a cave called Yunzhan (雲棧洞) in it; in that cave there had been a Luan Erjie (卵二姐) who, seeing he had some martial skill, took him on as head of the household.

basis_claims.quote: 初來時是一條黑胖漢，後來就變做一個長嘴大耳朵的獃子，腦後又有一溜鬃毛，身體粗糙怕人，頭臉就像個豬的模樣。食腸卻又甚大：一頓要吃三五斗米飯，早間點心也得百十個燒餅才夠。

statement.id: Dalam bab 18, Tuan Gao menggambarkan menantunya: mula-mula pria gemuk berkulit gelap, lalu berubah menjadi si dungu bermoncong panjang, bertelinga besar, berbulu kuduk di belakang kepala, dan berkepala seperti babi, yang sekali makan menghabiskan tiga hingga lima dou nasi.
statement.en: In chapter 18 old Gao describes his son-in-law: at first a dark, stout man, then a dull fellow with a long snout and big ears, a mane behind his head and a pig-like head and face, who eats three to five dou of rice at one meal.

basis_claims.quote: 他如今又會弄風，雲來霧去，走石飛砂，諕得我一家並左鄰右舍，俱不得安生。

statement.id: Tuan Gao menyebut kini ia dapat mengendalikan angin, mendatangkan awan dan kabut, serta menerbangkan batu dan pasir, sehingga keluarga dan tetangga tidak tenang.
statement.en: Old Gao says he can now stir up wind, bring clouds and mist, and make stones and sand fly, so that the family and neighbours cannot live in peace.

basis_claims.quote: 正行處，忽見一座高山，那怪把紅光結聚，現了本相，撞入洞內，取出一柄九齒釘鈀來戰。

statement.id: Dalam bab 19, si monster memusatkan cahaya merah, menampakkan wujud aslinya, menerobos masuk gua, dan membawa keluar sebuah garu bergigi sembilan (九齒釘鈀) untuk bertarung.
statement.en: In chapter 19 the creature gathers red light, shows his true form, rushes into his cave and brings out a nine-toothed rake (九齒釘鈀) to fight.

basis_claims.quote: 他本是天蓬元帥臨凡，只因錯投了胎，嘴臉像一個野豬模樣，其實性靈尚存。他說以相為姓，喚名豬剛鬣。

statement.id: Sun Wukong melaporkan bahwa monster itu aslinya Marsekal Tianpeng yang turun ke dunia, salah menjelma sehingga wajahnya seperti babi hutan namun akal batinnya tetap ada; ia mengaku bermarga dari rupanya dan bernama 豬剛鬣.
statement.en: Sun Wukong reports that the creature is really Marshal Tianpeng come down to the mortal world, who took the wrong birth and has a wild boar's face while his inner nature remains; he says he takes his surname from his looks and is named 豬剛鬣.

nezha.depicted_variant: One-headed lotus-body Nezha flying on two wind-fire wheels, carrying fire-tipped spear, golden ring and red silk.

visual_requirements.description: NEZHA in FENGSHEN YANYI resurrected youthful form, choose ONE HEAD exactly TWO ARMS TWO LEGS, not multihead variant from other texts. Pale youthful boy deity face white as powder (c14), modest opaque traditional lotus-inspired clothes cover entire torso and lower body (c28). Stands dynamically one foot on each of exactly TWO WIND-FIRE WHEELS, both burning physical wheels obvious beneath feet (c29,c04), streaks of flame follow wheels through natural clouds. One hand holds FIRE-TIPPED SPEAR (c29), other holds GOLDEN QIANKUN QUAN bracelet/ring (c15); one physical RED SILK HUNTIAN LING sash flowing around belly/shoulders in wind (c14,c15), not generic energy ribbons. Awe-inspiring determined protective child deity, no modern animated film hair/face/costumes, not comic caricature. Low-camera huge presence above tiny mountains.

nezha.aura: One-headed lotus-body Nezha flying on two wind-fire wheels, carrying fire-tipped spear, golden ring and red silk.

basis_claims.quote: As in traditional folklore, Nezha flies around swiftly on his wind fire wheels, so he is also regarded as the tutelary god of many professional drivers, like trucks, taxis, or sightseeing bus drivers.

statement.id: Seperti dalam cerita rakyat tradisional, Nezha terbang cepat dengan roda angin-api (風火輪), sehingga ia juga dianggap dewa pelindung banyak pengemudi profesional, seperti sopir truk, taksi, atau bus wisata.
statement.en: As in traditional folklore, Nezha flies around swiftly on his wind fire wheels, so he is also regarded as the tutelary god of many professional drivers, such as truck, taxi, or sightseeing-bus drivers.

basis_claims.quote: 有一肉毬，滴溜溜圓轉如輪。李靖大驚，望肉毬上一劍砍去，劃然有聲。分開肉毬，跳出一個小孩兒來，滿地紅光，面如傅粉，右手套一金鐲，肚腹上圍著一塊紅綾，金光射目。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Li Jing menebas sebuah bola daging yang berputar seperti roda; bola itu terbelah dan keluarlah seorang anak laki-laki dengan cahaya merah, bermuka putih, bergelang emas di tangan kanan, dan berselempang kain merah di perutnya.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Li Jing slashes a ball of flesh that turns like a wheel; it splits open and a small boy jumps out amid red light, with a face white as powder, a golden bracelet on his right hand, and a red silk cloth around his belly.

basis_claims.quote: 這位神聖下世，出在陳塘關，乃姜子牙先行官是也；靈珠子化身。金鐲是「乾坤圈」，紅綾名曰「混天綾。」此物乃是乾元山鎮金光洞之寶。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, narator menyatakan bahwa dewa ini lahir di Chentang Pass sebagai penjelmaan Lingzhu Zi dan pembuka jalan bagi Jiang Ziya; gelang emasnya bernama Qiankun Quan (乾坤圈) dan kain merahnya Huntian Ling (混天綾), pusaka Gua Jinguang di Gunung Qianyuan.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, the narrator states that this divine being was born at Chentang Pass as an incarnation of Lingzhu Zi and as Jiang Ziya's vanguard; the golden bracelet is the Qiankun Quan (乾坤圈) and the red silk the Huntian Ling (混天綾), treasures of Jinguang Cave on Mount Qianyuan.

basis_claims.quote: 真人將花勒下瓣兒，鋪成三才，又將荷葉梗兒折成三百骨節，三個荷葉，按上、中、下，按天、地、人。真人將一粒金丹放於居中

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, Taiyi Zhenren menata kelopak teratai dan tangkai daun teratai menjadi tubuh dengan tiga ratus ruas tulang, lalu menaruh sebutir pil emas di tengahnya.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, Taiyi Zhenren arranges lotus petals and lotus-leaf stalks into a body with three hundred joints of bone, then places a grain of golden elixir at its center.

basis_claims.quote: 外面有三公子，腳踏風火二輪，手提火尖鎗，口稱老爺姓諱，不知何故，請老爺定奪。

statement.id: Dalam Fengshen Yanyi, para pengawal melaporkan bahwa putra ketiga berdiri di atas dua roda angin-api dan memegang tombak berujung api.
statement.en: In Fengshen Yanyi, the guards report that the third son stands on two wind-fire wheels and holds a fire-tipped spear.

krishna.depicted_variant: Blue-black Krishna in yellow robe and peacock feather lifting Govardhan with one hand to shelter villagers and cattle from rain.

visual_requirements.description: Blue-black skin, yellow robe and peacock feather
Govardhan upheld effortlessly in one hand during deluge, villagers sheltered

krishna.aura: Blue-black Krishna in yellow robe and peacock feather lifting Govardhan with one hand to shelter villagers and cattle from rain.

basis_claims.quote: he enchanted the gopis with his divine flute playing, performed the celestial Rasa Lila, and lifted Govardhan Hill to protect his community from devastating rains. He later defeated Kamsa and restored order in Mathura. He went on to establish the city of Dvaraka and played a central role in the Kurukshetra War, serving as Arjuna’s charioteer

statement.id: Krishna memikat para gopi dengan seruling ilahinya, mengangkat Bukit Govardhan untuk melindungi kaumnya dari hujan dahsyat, mengalahkan Kamsa, mendirikan kota Dvaraka, dan berperan penting dalam perang Kurukshetra sebagai kusir kereta Arjuna.
statement.en: Krishna enchanted the gopis with his flute, lifted Govardhan Hill to protect his community from devastating rains, defeated Kamsa, founded the city of Dvaraka and played a central role in the Kurukshetra War as Arjuna's charioteer.

basis_claims.quote: Krishna also found time to lift the mountain Govardhana to foil a terrible deluge sent by Indra, to conquer Saubha, the floating city of the Titans (daityas), got the better of the sea-god Varuna, and even managed to steal the divine discus possessed by the fire-god Agni.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Krishna mengangkat Gunung Govardhana untuk menggagalkan banjir dahsyat kiriman Indra, menaklukkan Saubha kota terapung para Titan, mengungguli dewa laut Varuna, dan mencuri cakram ilahi milik dewa api Agni.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Krishna lifted Mount Govardhana to foil a terrible deluge sent by Indra, conquered Saubha, the floating city of the Titans, got the better of the sea-god Varuna and stole the divine discus of the fire-god Agni.

basis_claims.quote: Krishna is typically portrayed in Hindu art with a dark skin (usually blue-black), and he may carry the cakra discus Vajranabha and the club Kaumodaki – both given to him by Agni. He typically wears a yellow robe, has a peacock feather in his long black hair, and commonly plays a flute.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam seni Hindu Krishna biasanya digambarkan berkulit gelap (biasanya biru-hitam), dapat membawa cakram Vajranabha dan gada Kaumodaki pemberian Agni, berjubah kuning, berbulu merak di rambutnya, dan umumnya memainkan seruling.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Krishna is typically portrayed in Hindu art with dark skin (usually blue-black), may carry the discus Vajranabha and the club Kaumodaki given by Agni, wears a yellow robe, has a peacock feather in his hair and commonly plays a flute.

basis_claims.quote: Having thus made up his mind, Krishna immediately upheld the mountain Govardhana with one hand as if in sport ... For seven days and nights did the vast clouds, despatched by Indra, pour down showers upon the Gokula of Nanda, to destroy the dwellers, but they were protected by the height of the mountain.

statement.id: Dalam Wisnu Purana, Krishna mengangkat Gunung Govardhana dengan satu tangan seolah bermain, dan selama tujuh hari tujuh malam awan kiriman Indra menurunkan hujan atas Gokula milik Nanda tetapi para penghuninya terlindung oleh ketinggian gunung itu.
statement.en: In the Vishnu Purana, Krishna upheld Mount Govardhana with one hand as if in sport, and for seven days and nights the clouds sent by Indra poured showers on the Gokula of Nanda, but its dwellers were protected by the height of the mountain.

sun-wukong.depicted_variant: Macaque Sun Wukong somersaulting on clouds with black iron gold-banded staff and circlet.

visual_requirements.description: SUN WUKONG as original Ming novel Journey to the West monkey pilgrim, one living furry MACAQUE with actual monkey muzzle and ears, one head two arms two legs (c33,c38), expressive cunning defiant face, simple historic Chinese opaque pilgrim tunic, trousers and cloth boots, tight golden head circlet (c10). Dynamic full-body aerial SOMERSAULT ON A CLOUD high above tiny distant mountain peaks (c40,c08), clear actual clouds rather than neon energy ribbons. Both hands firmly grip one BLACK IRON STAFF with GOLD BANDS at its TWO ENDS (c41), oversized heavy staff silhouette; NO lettered inscription because catalogue images have no text. Diagonal fearless motion and monumental perspective, rich fur detail, heavenly grandeur, no human anime face, modern branded armor or movie/game/comic designs.

sun-wukong.aura: Macaque Sun Wukong somersaulting on clouds with black iron gold-banded staff and circlet.

basis_claims.quote: The ability, oft portrayed as Wukong riding a nimbus-like cloud, requires a magic hand sign, an oral spell, a fist clench, and a body shake. Wukong's master Puti Zushi taught this ability to the monkey to give him a style of flying that complements his penchant for jumping.

statement.id: Kemampuan salto awan sering digambarkan sebagai Wukong menunggang awan; guru Puti Zushi mengajarkannya agar Wukong memiliki cara terbang yang cocok dengan kegemarannya melompat.
statement.en: The cloud somersault is often portrayed as Wukong riding a cloud; his master Puti Zushi taught it to give him a style of flying suited to his love of jumping.

basis_claims.quote: a magical circlet which, once the Monkey King is tricked into putting it on, can never be removed. When Tang Sanzang chants a certain sutra, the band will tighten and cause an unbearable headache.

statement.id: Guanyin memberi Tang Sanzang sebuah lingkaran gaib dari Buddha yang tidak dapat dilepas setelah Raja Kera dibujuk memakainya; saat Tang Sanzang melafalkan sutra tertentu, lingkaran itu mengetat dan menimbulkan sakit kepala tak tertahankan.
statement.en: Guanyin gives Tang Sanzang a magical circlet from the Buddha that can never be removed once the Monkey King is tricked into wearing it; when Tang Sanzang chants a certain sutra the band tightens and causes an unbearable headache.

basis_claims.quote: 內育仙胞，一日迸裂，產一石卵，似圓毬樣大。因見風，化作一個石猴，五官俱備，四肢皆全。

statement.id: Dalam teks asli novel (bab 1), sebuah batu yang mengandung "kantong gaib" pecah pada suatu hari dan melahirkan telur batu sebesar bola; terkena angin, telur itu menjadi kera batu dengan panca indra dan keempat anggota badan lengkap.
statement.en: In the original text (chapter 1), a stone holding an immortal "womb" split open one day and produced a stone egg the size of a ball; touched by the wind it became a stone monkey with all five senses and four limbs complete.

basis_claims.quote: 你身軀雖是鄙陋，卻像個食松果的猢猻。我與你就身上取個姓氏，意思教你姓『猢』。猢字去了個獸傍，乃是個古月。古者，老也；月者，陰也。老陰不能化育，教你姓『猻』倒好。猻字去了獸傍，乃是個子系。子者，兒男也；系者。嬰細也，正合嬰兒之本論。教你姓『孫』罷。

statement.id: Sang guru menilai tubuh si kera buruk tetapi mirip kera pemakan buah pinus, lalu memberinya marga "孫" setelah membahas aksara 猢 dan 猻.
statement.en: The patriarch says the monkey's body is unlovely yet like a pine-nut-eating macaque (猢猻), and after discussing the characters 猢 and 猻 gives him the surname "孫".

basis_claims.quote: 這朵雲，捻著訣，念動真言，攢緊了拳，將身一抖，跳將起來，一觔斗就有十萬八千里路哩。

statement.id: Sang guru mengajarkan awan salto: dengan rumus tangan, mantra, kepalan, dan guncangan tubuh, sekali salto menempuh seratus delapan ribu li.
statement.en: The patriarch teaches the somersault cloud: with a hand sign, a spell, a clenched fist and a shake of the body, one somersault covers 108,000 li.

basis_claims.quote: 悟空十分歡喜，拿出海藏看時，原來兩頭是兩個金箍，中間乃一段烏鐵。緊挨箍有鐫成的一行字，喚做：「如意金箍棒，重一萬三千五百斤。

statement.id: Dalam bab 3, senjata yang dipilih Wukong berujung dua gelang emas dengan batang besi hitam di tengah, bertuliskan "如意金箍棒" (tongkat gelang emas sesuka hati) seberat 13.500 kati.
statement.en: In chapter 3 the weapon Wukong takes has two gold bands at its ends and a length of black iron between them, inscribed "如意金箍棒" (Ruyi Jingu Bang), weighing 13,500 jin.

vishnu.depicted_variant: Four-armed blue Vishnu bearing discus, conch, mace and lotus in Vaikuntha, with solar-domain radiance.

visual_requirements.description: VISHNU, respectful majestic Hindu Preserver, living blue-skinned deity exactly FOUR ARMS and one head. Each separate hand holds one clearly distinct object: Sudarsana discus, conch shell, heavy mace and lotus (c21,c22). Stands protectively on a lotus platform overlooking the magnificent shining gold and jewel city Vaikuntha with lotus lakes on Mount Meru (c13). Crown and modest traditional opaque robes; benevolent commanding gaze. Spectacular warm SOLAR RADIANCE emphasizes his documented solar association Surya Narayana (c23), source-supported illumination rather than invented attack or sci-fi beams. Low-angle monumental form above tiny distant gold palaces, readable hands, all four attributes visible, rich brushwork.

vishnu.aura: Four-armed blue Vishnu bearing discus, conch, mace and lotus in Vaikuntha, with solar-domain radiance.

basis_claims.quote: He is considered to live in the city of Vaikuntha on Mt. Meru, where everything is made of shining gold and fabulous jewels and where there are lakes resplendent with lotus flowers.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu dianggap tinggal di kota Vaikuntha di Gunung Meru, tempat segalanya terbuat dari emas berkilau dan permata, dengan danau-danau yang dipenuhi teratai.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu is considered to live in the city of Vaikuntha on Mt. Meru, where everything is made of shining gold and jewels and lakes are resplendent with lotus flowers.

basis_claims.quote: he is most often depicted coloured blue and sometimes rides Garuda, a gigantic half-man, half-bird creature which devours snakes.
basis_claims.locator: How is Vishnu Representated in Art?

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam seni Hindu Wisnu paling sering digambarkan berwarna biru dan kadang menunggang Garuda, makhluk raksasa setengah manusia setengah burung yang memangsa ular.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, in Hindu art Vishnu is most often depicted coloured blue and sometimes rides Garuda, a gigantic half-man, half-bird creature that devours snakes.

basis_claims.quote: His weapon is the Sudarsanacakra or discus (chakra), perhaps representative of his association with the sun but also, with its thousand spokes, symbolic of the wheel of time. He often holds various other objects in his (usually) four hands such as a conch shell trumpet which sounds the Creation, a mace (gada) or a sword which represents strength, and a lotus
basis_claims.locator: How is Vishnu Representated in Art?

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, senjata Wisnu adalah cakram Sudarsanacakra, mungkin lambang kaitannya dengan matahari dan roda waktu; di keempat tangannya ia sering memegang kerang sangkakala penanda Penciptaan, gada atau pedang lambang kekuatan, dan teratai.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu's weapon is the Sudarsanacakra discus, perhaps representing his link with the sun and the wheel of time; in his usually four hands he often holds a conch shell trumpet that sounds the Creation, a mace or sword representing strength, and a lotus.

basis_claims.quote: Certainly, Vishnu was associated with the sun, as one of his other names suggests - Surya Narayana.
basis_claims.locator: The Legend of the Three Steps

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Wisnu dikaitkan dengan matahari, seperti ditunjukkan salah satu namanya yang lain, Surya Narayana.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Vishnu was associated with the sun, as one of his other names, Surya Narayana, suggests.

zeus.depicted_variant: Regal dark-bearded Zeus hurling lightning above Olympus, bearing sceptre with eagle.

visual_requirements.description: Regal mature dark-bearded man with lightning javelin, sceptre and eagle.
Sky and weather dominion manifests as lightning and storm above Olympus.

zeus.aura: Monumental king of heaven with documented lightning and storm.

basis_claims.quote: is the supreme deity of the Greek pantheon. He is a sky and thunder god in ancient Greek religion and mythology, who rules as king of the gods on Mount Olympus.

statement.id: Zeus (Ζεύς) adalah dewa tertinggi jajaran dewa Yunani, dewa langit dan guntur dalam agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno yang memerintah sebagai raja para dewa di Gunung Olimpus.
statement.en: Zeus (Ζεύς) is the supreme deity of the Greek pantheon, a sky and thunder god of ancient Greek religion and mythology who rules as king of the gods on Mount Olympus.

basis_claims.quote: ZEUS was the King of the Gods and the god of the sky, weather, law and order, destiny and fate, and kingship. He was depicted as a regal, mature man with a sturdy figure and dark beard. His usual attributes were a lightning bolt, a royal sceptre and an eagle.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus raja para dewa dan dewa langit, cuaca, hukum dan ketertiban, takdir, serta kekuasaan raja, digambarkan sebagai laki-laki dewasa berwibawa berjanggut gelap, dengan atribut petir, tongkat kerajaan, dan elang.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus was King of the Gods and god of sky, weather, law and order, destiny and kingship, shown as a regal mature man with a dark beard, with the lightning bolt, royal sceptre and eagle.

basis_claims.quote: Zeus was the king of the 12 Olympian gods and the supreme god in Greek religion. Zeus is often referred to as the Father, as the god of thunder, and the 'cloud-gatherer'. Zeus controlled the weather and offered signs and omens.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Zeus raja kedua belas dewa Olimpus dan dewa tertinggi agama Yunani; ia mengendalikan cuaca, memberi tanda dan pertanda, dan menegakkan keadilan serta ketertiban dari Gunung Olimpus.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Zeus was king of the twelve Olympians and supreme Greek god; he controlled the weather, gave signs and omens, and dispensed justice and order from Mount Olympus.

basis_claims.quote: Zeus liberated the six giant-sons of Heaven from the pit of Tartaros. In gratitude the Kyklopes (Cyclopes) armed him with lightning-bolts and the Hekatonkheires (Hundred-Handed) aided him in his assault on the Titanes with volleys of thrown boulders. Kronos and his allies were eventually defeated and banished to a prison beneath the earth.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Zeus membebaskan enam putra raksasa Langit dari jurang Tartaros; para Kyklopes mempersenjatainya dengan petir dan para Hekatonkheires membantunya menyerang Titan dengan lemparan batu, hingga Kronos dan sekutunya kalah dan dibuang ke penjara di bawah bumi.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus freed the six giant sons of Heaven from the pit of Tartaros; the Kyklopes armed him with lightning-bolts and the Hekatonkheires aided his assault on the Titanes with thrown boulders, until Kronos and his allies were defeated and banished to a prison beneath the earth.

basis_claims.quote: The earth-goddess Gaia (Gaea), angered by the imprisonment of the Titanes, urged the Giants to rise up against the gods of Olympos. They laid siege to the heavenly fortress but Zeus laid low their king and many others with his deadly lightning-bolts.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Gaia yang murka atas pemenjaraan para Titan mendorong para Giant memberontak melawan dewa-dewa Olimpos; mereka mengepung benteng surgawi, tetapi Zeus menjatuhkan raja mereka dan banyak lainnya dengan petirnya yang mematikan.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Gaia, angered by the imprisonment of the Titanes, urged the Giants to rise against the gods of Olympos; they besieged the heavenly fortress but Zeus laid low their king and many others with his deadly lightning-bolts.

basis_claims.quote: Zeus' most distinctive attribute was his stylized lightning bolt which he wielded in his hand like a javelin. His other attributes included a royal sceptre, a throne, an eagle, a miniature Nike (winged goddess of victory), and the aigis (a goat-skin arm-guard).

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, atribut Zeus yang paling khas adalah petirnya yang digenggam seperti lembing; atribut lainnya mencakup tongkat kerajaan, takhta, elang, Nike mini, dan aigis (pelindung lengan dari kulit kambing).
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Zeus' most distinctive attribute was his lightning bolt wielded like a javelin; others included a royal sceptre, a throne, an eagle, a miniature Nike and the aigis (a goat-skin arm-guard).

apollo-q37340.depicted_variant: Solar-associated Phoebus Apollo at Delphi with silver bow, tortoiseshell lyre and oracle tripod.

visual_requirements.description: APOLLO in later Greek Phoebus solar association (c24,c25), one living handsome beardless youth with long curled hair (c05), one head two arms two legs, opaque flowing chiton and mantle fully covers torso/lower body. Dominates low-angle view above Delphi rocky sanctuary (c02,c06); one hand carries SILVER BOW and quiver, the other holds a distinct tortoiseshell LYRE (c22,c37), bronze oracle tripod at his feet (c33,c37). Immense golden SUN radiance behind him expresses documented later solar association, light and healing domain (c01,c24,c25); not a torch or invented lightning/fire attacks. Confident commanding beautiful bright gaze, dramatic wind and warm rays against deep mountain shadow, original active composition, unmistakable deity.

apollo-q37340.aura: Solar-associated Phoebus Apollo at Delphi with silver bow, tortoiseshell lyre and oracle tripod.

basis_claims.quote: Apollo is one of the Olympian deities in ancient Greek religion and mythology. His numerous functions include light, healing, prophecy, music, poetry, and archery. He is the son of Zeus and Leto, and the twin brother of Artemis, goddess of the hunt.

statement.id: Apollo adalah salah satu dewa Olimpus dalam agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno, dengan fungsi cahaya, penyembuhan, nubuat, musik, puisi, dan panahan; putra Zeus dan Leto, saudara kembar Artemis.
statement.en: Apollo is an Olympian god of ancient Greek religion and myth whose functions include light, healing, prophecy, music, poetry and archery; son of Zeus and Leto, twin of Artemis.

basis_claims.quote: As the patron deity of Delphi (Apollo Pythios), Apollo is an oracular god—the prophetic deity of the Delphic Oracle and the deity of ritual purification. His oracles were often consulted for guidance in various matters.

statement.id: Sebagai dewa pelindung Delphi, Apollo adalah dewa orakel Delphi dan dewa penyucian ritual, dan nubuatnya sering dimintai petunjuk.
statement.en: As patron of Delphi, Apollo is the god of the Delphic oracle and of ritual purification, and his oracles were often consulted.

basis_claims.quote: APOLLON (Apollo) was the Olympian god of prophecy and oracles, music, song and poetry, archery, healing, plague and disease, and the protection of the young. He was depicted as a handsome, beardless youth with long hair

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Apollon (Apollo) adalah dewa Olimpus nubuat dan orakel, musik, lagu dan puisi, panahan, penyembuhan, wabah dan penyakit, serta perlindungan anak muda; ia digambarkan sebagai pemuda tampan tanpa janggut berambut panjang.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Apollon (Apollo) was the Olympian god of prophecy and oracles, music, song and poetry, archery, healing, plague and disease, and the protection of the young, depicted as a handsome, beardless youth with long hair.

basis_claims.quote: Apollo was perhaps the most loved of all the gods. He was worshipped at Delphi and Delos, amongst the most famous of all Greek religious sanctuaries.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Apollo mungkin dewa yang paling dicintai, dan dipuja di Delphi dan Delos, dua tempat suci agama Yunani yang paling terkenal.
statement.en: According to the World History Encyclopedia, Apollo was perhaps the most loved of the gods, worshipped at Delphi and Delos, among the most famous of Greek religious sanctuaries.

basis_claims.quote: a silver bow - symbolic of his prowess as an archer. a kithara (or lyre) - made from the shell of a tortoise, this was symbolic of Apollo's ability in music and his leadership of the chorus of the nine Muses.

statement.id: Benda yang dikaitkan dengan Apollo antara lain busur perak, lambang kehebatannya memanah, dan kithara (lira) dari cangkang kura-kura, lambang kemampuan musiknya dan kepemimpinannya atas paduan suara sembilan Muse.
statement.en: Objects associated with Apollo include a silver bow, symbolic of his prowess as an archer, and a kithara (or lyre) made from a tortoise shell, symbolic of his musical ability and his leadership of the chorus of the nine Muses.

basis_claims.quote: The god is frequently associated with the sun (as Phoebus Apollo) and the sun god Helios, but modern scholars mostly agree that the link between Apollo and Helios does not go further back than the 5th century BCE.

statement.id: Sang dewa sering dikaitkan dengan matahari (sebagai Phoebus Apollo) dan dewa matahari Helios, tetapi para ahli modern umumnya sepakat bahwa kaitan Apollo dengan Helios tidak lebih tua daripada abad ke-5 SM.
statement.en: The god is often associated with the sun (as Phoebus Apollo) and the sun god Helios, but modern scholars mostly agree the link between Apollo and Helios goes back no further than the 5th century BCE.

basis_claims.quote: the view which was almost universal among the later poets, mythographers, and philesophers, and according to which Apollo was identical with Helios, or the Sun
basis_claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology di theoi.com, pandangan yang hampir universal di kalangan penyair, penulis mitologi, dan filsuf kemudian adalah bahwa Apollo identik dengan Helios, sang Matahari.
statement.en: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology on theoi.com, the view almost universal among later poets, mythographers and philosophers was that Apollo was identical with Helios, the Sun.

basis_claims.quote: Apollo's most common attributes were the bow and arrow. Other attributes of his included the kithara (an advanced version of the common lyre), the plectrum and the sword. Another common emblem was the sacrificial tripod, representing his prophetic powers.

statement.id: Atribut Apollo yang paling umum adalah busur dan anak panah; atribut lainnya mencakup kithara, plektrum, dan pedang, dan lambang umum lain adalah trivet persembahan yang melambangkan kekuatan nubuatnya.
statement.en: Apollo's most common attributes were the bow and arrow; others included the kithara, the plectrum and the sword, and another common emblem was the sacrificial tripod, representing his prophetic powers.

basis_claims.quote: Apollo appears frequently in all media of ancient Greek art, most often as a beautiful, beardless youth. He is easily identified with either a kithara or a lyre, a bronze tripod (signifying his oracle at Delphi), a deer (which he often fights over with Hercules), and a bow and quiver.
basis_claims.locator: How is Apollo Represented in Art?

statement.id: Apollo sering muncul dalam semua media seni Yunani kuno, paling sering sebagai pemuda rupawan tanpa janggut, dan mudah dikenali dari kithara atau lira, trivet perunggu (penanda orakelnya di Delphi), rusa, serta busur dan tempat anak panah.
statement.en: Apollo appears often in all media of ancient Greek art, most often as a beautiful beardless youth, and is easily identified by a kithara or lyre, a bronze tripod (signifying his oracle at Delphi), a deer, and a bow and quiver.

erlang-shen.depicted_variant: Three-eyed Erlang in colossal novel transformation, with three-pointed spear, waist bow and hunting hound.

visual_requirements.description: ERLANG SHEN as noble young living Chinese warrior deity with a clearly THIRD truth-seeing EYE in the centre of forehead (c06), exactly one head two arms two legs; dignified original historic Chinese court-warrior robes, no modern videogame armor. Towering colossal form ten thousand zhang tall from Journey to the West (c19), cloud deck at knees, tiny mountain chain beneath as comparative scale. Holds THREE-POINTED DOUBLE-EDGED SPEAR firmly with both hands, spear physical not lightning emitter (c19,c21); pellet bow at waist (c21); one slender loyal hunting hound alongside him (c06,c20), no horns/wings. Imposing just authority and giant clear silhouette in storm-clearing natural light, overwhelming scale is documented transformation rather than invented power aura.

erlang-shen.aura: Three-eyed Erlang in colossal novel transformation, with three-pointed spear, waist bow and hunting hound.

basis_claims.quote: He is commonly depicted as a young man with a third, truth-seeing eye in the middle of his forehead, wielding a three-pronged spear, and being accompanied by his loyal hunting dog, Xiaotian Quan.

statement.id: Ia biasa digambarkan sebagai pemuda dengan mata ketiga yang melihat kebenaran di tengah dahinya, bersenjata tombak bermata tiga, dan ditemani anjing pemburu setianya, Xiaotian Quan.
statement.en: He is commonly depicted as a young man with a third, truth-seeing eye in the middle of his forehead, wielding a three-pronged spear, and accompanied by his loyal hunting dog, Xiaotian Quan.

basis_claims.quote: 真君抖擻神威，搖身一變，變得身高萬丈，兩隻手舉著三尖兩刃神鋒，好便似華山頂上之峰

statement.id: Dalam Perjalanan ke Barat, dalam duel melawan Sun Wukong, Erlang mengerahkan wibawa ilahinya, berubah wujud menjadi setinggi sepuluh ribu zhang, dan mengangkat tombak sakti bermata tiga berbilah dua dengan kedua tangannya.
statement.en: In Journey to the West, in the duel with Sun Wukong, Erlang summons his divine might, transforms into a figure ten thousand zhang tall, and raises his three-pointed, double-edged divine spear with both hands.

basis_claims.quote: 猴王只顧苦戰七聖，卻不知天上墜下這兵器，打中了天靈，立不穩腳，跌了一跤，爬將起來就跑。被二郎爺爺的細犬趕上，照腿肚子上一口，又扯了一跌。
basis_claims.locator: 第六回, the capture of Sun Wukong

statement.id: Dalam Perjalanan ke Barat, ketika Sun Wukong sedang bertarung melawan tujuh dewa, sebuah senjata jatuh dari langit mengenai kepalanya sehingga ia terjatuh; anjing pemburu (細犬) milik Erlang mengejarnya, menggigit betisnya, dan menjatuhkannya lagi.
statement.en: In Journey to the West, while Sun Wukong is fighting the seven sages, a weapon falls from heaven and strikes his head so that he stumbles; Erlang's hound (細犬) catches up, bites his calf, and pulls him down again.

basis_claims.quote: 腰挎彈弓新月樣，手執三尖兩刃槍。斧劈桃山曾救母，彈打鋋羅雙鳳凰。力誅八怪聲名遠，義結梅山七聖行。

statement.id: Dalam Perjalanan ke Barat, sebuah syair menggambarkan Erlang membawa busur peluru di pinggang dan memegang tombak bermata tiga berbilah dua; syair itu juga menyebut ia membelah Gunung Tao dengan kapak untuk menyelamatkan ibunya, serta mengikat persaudaraan dengan tujuh orang suci Meishan.
statement.en: In Journey to the West, a verse describes Erlang with a pellet bow at his waist and a three-pointed, double-edged spear in hand; it also says he split Peach Mountain with an axe to save his mother and swore brotherhood with the seven sages of Meishan.

basis_claims.quote: As a god, Erlang is a noble and powerful warrior who vanquishes demons and monsters, and embodies justice and righteousness.

statement.id: Sebagai dewa, Erlang adalah prajurit mulia dan perkasa yang menaklukkan iblis dan monster, serta mewujudkan keadilan dan kebenaran.
statement.en: As a god, Erlang is a noble and powerful warrior who vanquishes demons and monsters, and embodies justice and righteousness.

sha-wujing.depicted_variant: Tusking red-haired Sha Wujing with stove-lamp eyes, nine skulls and lengthened staff emerging from Flowing Sands River.

visual_requirements.description: SHA WUJING in original Journey to the West river-monster form, NOT a Japanese kappa. One imposing hideous humanoid with dark ashen gloomy face neither blue nor black, RED tangled hair and red beard, sword-like physical TUSKS, glaring eyes like two STOVE LAMPS (c26,c15), bare feet, exactly two arms and two legs; historic Chinese opaque river-pilgrim clothing, not ordinary human. NINE clean dry old ivory skulls, all clearly countable, strung on a cord around neck (c28,c34), no blood or victims. Both hands grasp one long plain demon-subduing STAFF, dramatically extended to a great length (c16), no added crescent shovel blade. Bursts from Flowing Sands River with powerful natural splash, river combat c06,c17,c30. Epic low camera with tiny far shore, fearsome dignified supernatural monster rather than costume actor, no generic magical water beams.

sha-wujing.aura: Tusking red-haired Sha Wujing with stove-lamp eyes, nine skulls and lengthened staff emerging from Flowing Sands River.

basis_claims.quote: He also knows 18 transformation methods and is highly effective in water combat.

statement.id: Ia juga menguasai 18 cara perubahan wujud dan sangat efektif dalam pertempuran di air.
statement.en: He also knows 18 transformation methods and is highly effective in water combat.

basis_claims.quote: Wujing's appearance was grisly. He had a red beard and sometimes had blue skin, and he was partially bald.

statement.id: Penampilan Wujing mengerikan: berjanggut merah, kadang berkulit biru, dan sebagian botak.
statement.en: Wujing's appearance was grisly: he had a red beard, sometimes blue skin, and was partially bald.

basis_claims.quote: Like Sun Wukong's Ruyi Jingu Bang, Wujing's Xiangyaobaozhang is capable of growing, shrinking, lengthening and shortening at will.

statement.id: Seperti Ruyi Jingu Bang milik Sun Wukong, Xiangyaobaozhang milik Wujing dapat membesar, mengecil, memanjang, dan memendek sesuka hati.
statement.en: Like Sun Wukong's Ruyi Jingu Bang, Wujing's Xiangyaobaozhang can grow, shrink, lengthen and shorten at will.

basis_claims.quote: During the Journey to the West, his swimming ability was useful.

statement.id: Selama Journey to the West, kemampuannya berenang berguna.
statement.en: During the Journey to the West his swimming ability was useful.

basis_claims.quote: 青不青，黑不黑，晦氣色臉；長不長，短不短，赤腳筋軀。眼光閃爍，好似灶底雙燈；口角丫叉，就如屠家火缽。獠牙撐劍刃，紅髮亂蓬鬆。一聲叱咤如雷吼，兩腳奔波似滾風。

statement.id: Dalam bab 8, monster dari sungai digambarkan berwajah suram tidak biru dan tidak hitam, berkaki telanjang, bermata berkilau seperti dua pelita tungku, bertaring mencuat seperti bilah pedang, berambut merah kusut, dan menggelegar seperti guntur.
statement.en: In chapter 8 the monster from the river is described with a gloomy face neither blue nor black, bare feet, eyes flashing like two stove lamps, tusks jutting like sword blades and tangled red hair, roaring like thunder.

basis_claims.quote: 凡吃的人頭，拋落流沙，竟沉水底。這個水，鵝毛也不能浮。惟有九個取經人的骷髏浮在水面，再不能沉。我以為異物，將索兒穿在一處，閑時拿來頑耍。

statement.id: Ia mengaku telah memakan banyak orang, termasuk para pengambil sutra sebelumnya; kepala mereka tenggelam di pasir mengalir, kecuali sembilan tengkorak yang mengapung, yang ia rangkai dengan tali untuk bermain.
statement.en: He admits to having eaten many people, including earlier scripture seekers; their heads sank in the flowing sands except nine skulls that floated, which he strung together on a cord to play with.

basis_claims.quote: 忽然見弱水三千，乃是流沙河界。菩薩道：「徒弟呀，此處卻是難行。取經人濁骨凡胎，如何得渡？」

statement.id: Guanyin dan muridnya tiba di wilayah Sungai Pasir Mengalir (流沙河), air lemah tiga ribu li, dan menilai bahwa pengambil sutra yang bertubuh fana sulit menyeberanginya.
statement.en: The bodhisattva and her attendant reach the region of the Flowing Sands River (流沙河), three thousand li of weak water, and judge that a scripture seeker of mortal flesh would find it hard to cross.

basis_claims.quote: 那悟淨不敢怠慢，即將頸項下掛的骷髏取下，用索子結作九宮，把菩薩葫蘆安在當中，請師父下岸。那長老遂登法船，坐於上面，果然穩似輕舟。

statement.id: Wujing melepas tengkorak dari lehernya, merangkainya dengan tali menjadi sembilan palas, dan menaruh labu Guanyin di tengah sebagai perahu pusaka; Tang Sanzang naik dan perahu itu setenang sampan ringan.
statement.en: Wujing takes the skulls from his neck, strings them into the nine palaces with the bodhisattva's gourd set in the middle as a dharma boat; the elder boards it and it proves steady as a light skiff.

aphrodite.depicted_variant: Fully clothed foam-born Aphrodite with magical girdle, mirror, apple, myrtle and dove.

visual_requirements.description: APHRODITE in Hesiod's sea-foam birth tradition, one living beautiful stately woman one head two arms two legs, fully clothed in flowing opaque classical robe and elaborately embroidered magical chest girdle (c48). Emerges majestically above immense SEA FOAM beside rocky Cyprus shore (c03,c34). One hand holds an apple, one hand a small mirror, a dove flies near shoulder (c05,c49), myrtle wreath (c49). Divine beauty, compassionate confident direct gaze, low camera and towering surf make her unmistakeable goddess rather than ordinary woman. Pearl-white foam and golden natural sunrise (c50 golden epithet) supply spectacular power of composition; no invented love lasers/hearts, fire, flight or magic ribbons. Exact glitter and wave shapes editorial staging; alive, not marble statue.

aphrodite.aura: Fully clothed foam-born Aphrodite with magical girdle, mirror, apple, myrtle and dove.

basis_claims.quote: In Homer's Iliad, she is the daughter of Zeus and Dione. In Hesiod's Theogony she is born from the foam ... produced by Uranus's genitals, which his son Cronus had severed and thrown into the sea. In the Odyssey, Aphrodite was married to Hephaestus

statement.id: Dalam Iliad karya Homer ia putri Zeus dan Dione; dalam Theogony karya Hesiod ia lahir dari buih yang dihasilkan kelamin Uranus yang dipotong dan dilemparkan ke laut oleh putranya, Kronos; dalam Odyssey Aphrodite menikah dengan Hephaestus.
statement.en: In Homer's Iliad she is the daughter of Zeus and Dione; in Hesiod's Theogony she is born from the foam produced by Uranus's genitals, which his son Cronus had severed and thrown into the sea; in the Odyssey Aphrodite was married to Hephaestus.

basis_claims.quote: APHRODITE was the Olympian goddess of love, beauty, pleasure and procreation. She was depicted as a beautiful woman often accompanied by the winged godling Eros (Love). Her attributes included a dove, apple, scallop shell and mirror.

statement.id: Menurut theoi.com, Aphrodite adalah dewi Olimpus cinta, kecantikan, kesenangan, dan keturunan, digambarkan sebagai perempuan cantik yang sering ditemani dewa kecil bersayap Eros (Cinta); atributnya meliputi merpati, apel, kerang, dan cermin.
statement.en: According to theoi.com, Aphrodite was the Olympian goddess of love, beauty, pleasure and procreation, depicted as a beautiful woman often accompanied by the winged godling Eros (Love); her attributes included a dove, apple, scallop shell and mirror.

basis_claims.quote: According to Hesiod and the Homeric hymn on Aphrodite, the goddess after rising from the foam first approached the island of Cythera, and thence went to Cyprus
basis_claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut Hesiod dan Himne Homerik untuk Aphrodite, setelah bangkit dari buih sang dewi pertama-tama mendekati Pulau Kythera, lalu pergi ke Siprus.
statement.en: According to Hesiod and the Homeric hymn on Aphrodite, the goddess after rising from the foam first approached the island of Cythera and from there went to Cyprus.

basis_claims.quote: She is usually clothed in Archaic and Classical art and wears an elaborately embroidered band or girdle across her chest which held her magic powers of love, desire, and seductive allurement.
basis_claims.locator: How is Aphrodite Represented in Art?

statement.id: Dalam seni Arkaik dan Klasik ia biasanya berpakaian dan mengenakan pita atau ikat pinggang bersulam rumit melintang di dadanya, yang menyimpan kekuatan ajaibnya akan cinta, hasrat, dan daya pikat.
statement.en: In Archaic and Classical art she is usually clothed and wears an elaborately embroidered band or girdle across her chest which held her magic powers of love, desire and seductive allurement.

basis_claims.quote: The goddess is often identified with one or more of the following: a mirror, an apple, a myrtle wreath, a sacred bird or dove, a sceptre, and a flower.
basis_claims.locator: How is Aphrodite Represented in Art?

statement.id: Sang dewi sering dikenali dari satu atau lebih benda berikut: cermin, apel, karangan myrtus, burung suci atau merpati, tongkat kerajaan, dan bunga.
statement.en: The goddess is often identified by one or more of the following: a mirror, an apple, a myrtle wreath, a sacred bird or dove, a sceptre and a flower.

basis_claims.quote: Hesiod describes the goddess as 'quick-glancing', 'foam-born', 'smile-loving', and most often as 'golden Aphrodite'.

statement.id: Hesiod menggambarkan sang dewi sebagai "bermata cepat", "lahir dari buih", "pencinta senyum", dan paling sering sebagai "Aphrodite yang keemasan".
statement.en: Hesiod describes the goddess as "quick-glancing", "foam-born", "smile-loving", and most often as "golden Aphrodite".

vietnamese-dragon.depicted_variant: Living Lê Vietnamese dragon with forked horn, prominent lionlike head and two five-clawed feet ascending from water.

visual_requirements.description: A LIVING LÊ-DYNASTY VIETNAMESE RỒNG, choose only Lê variant matching reference, not the hornless Lý form. Raised lion-like dragon head with wide forehead, great prominent nose and strong eyes, one FORKED HORN, long curving body in TWO major sinuous bends, exactly TWO splayed feet each bearing FIVE sharp claws (c11,c26). No leathery wings, no extra hindleg pair, no Lý-specific nose crest/jewel or mixed dynasty anatomy. Ascends from river water benignly toward gathering rain clouds, natural spray and soft rain over distant rice fields (c02,c22); not firebreathing or menacing villagers. Fully living scales, mane and muscles, not a stone staircase ornament, dominant graceful silhouette, natural warm dawn illuminating wet surfaces, no glowing mist/lasers.

vietnamese-dragon.aura: Living Lê Vietnamese dragon with forked horn, prominent lionlike head and two five-clawed feet ascending from water.

basis_claims.quote: The dragon was symbolic of bringing rain, essential for agriculture. It represents the emperor, the prosperity and power of the nation. Similar to the Chinese dragon (which has also influenced and appeared in Japan and Korea as fierce but benevolent serpentine dragons alike), the Vietnamese dragon is the symbol of yang, representing the universe, life, existence, and growth.

statement.id: Naga melambangkan pembawa hujan yang penting bagi pertanian, mewakili kaisar serta kemakmuran dan kekuatan bangsa; seperti naga Tiongkok yang galak tetapi baik hati, naga Vietnam adalah lambang yang: alam semesta, kehidupan, keberadaan, dan pertumbuhan.
statement.en: The dragon symbolized rain for agriculture and represents the emperor and the nation's prosperity and power; like the fierce but benevolent Chinese dragon, it is a symbol of yang: universe, life, existence and growth.

basis_claims.quote: These dragons were majestic, with lion-heads. Instead of a fiery crest, they have a large nose. Their bodies only curve in two sections. Their feet have five sharp claws.

statement.id: Naga masa Lê-Mạc megah dengan kepala singa; alih-alih jambul api, mereka berhidung besar, tubuhnya hanya melengkung di dua bagian, dan kakinya berkuku tajam lima.
statement.en: Dragons of the Lê-Mạc period were majestic, with lion-heads; instead of a fiery crest they have a large nose, their bodies curve in only two sections, and their feet have five sharp claws.

basis_claims.quote: But unlike the Chinese dragons, which were shown descending from heaven and spitting fire, the Vietnamese dragons were shown asecending from water. Though imposing and fierce, the Vietnamese dragons were never threatening.

statement.id: Berbeda dari naga Tiongkok yang digambarkan turun dari langit dan menyemburkan api, naga Vietnam digambarkan naik dari air; walau megah dan garang, naga Vietnam tidak pernah mengancam.
statement.en: Unlike Chinese dragons, shown descending from heaven and spitting fire, Vietnamese dragons were shown ascending from water; though imposing and fierce, they were never threatening.

basis_claims.quote: The dragon took on a whole new appearance under the Le Dynasty (early 15th to end of 18th centuries). With a raised head, forked horn, wide forehead, prominent nose, large, forceful eyes, five claws, and two splayed feet, a dragon crept up the balustrade of Kinh Thien Hall’s central staircase.

statement.id: Naga mendapat rupa yang sama sekali baru pada masa dinasti Lê (awal abad ke-15 hingga akhir abad ke-18): berkepala tegak, bertanduk bercabang, berdahi lebar, berhidung menonjol, bermata besar dan tajam, berkuku lima, dan berkaki dua yang terentang; seekor naga merayap naik di pagar tangga tengah Aula Kính Thiên.
statement.en: The dragon took on a whole new appearance under the Lê dynasty (early 15th to end of 18th centuries): a raised head, forked horn, wide forehead, prominent nose, large forceful eyes, five claws and two splayed feet; one dragon creeps up the balustrade of the central staircase of Kinh Thien Hall.

bedawang.depicted_variant: Living fiery cosmic Bedawang supporting Bali, stabilized by two separate nagas.

visual_requirements.description: BEDAWANG NALA, living enormous BALINESE COSMIC TURTLE supporting the WHOLE ISLAND OF BALI on broad shell (c01,c18,c21), one turtle head, FOUR coherent turtle flippers/legs and one short tail, real wet reptile skin and ridged shell. Exactly TWO distinct enormous NAGAS Basuki and Anantabhoga coil around shell to stabilize him, their separate serpent heads clearly readable (c03,c07,c19), not extra turtle heads. Turtle has documented fiery HAIR-like flame fringe and gaping fiery MOUTH (c06,c15), local restrained orange flame, not arbitrary glowing envelope. Undersea/world-support cutaway artistic view with shell rising beneath island rootmass, tiny temples and mountains on island show cosmic size. Turtle slowly shifts weight with subtle geological cracking of supported rock to imply earthquake c18, no destruction victims. Respectful sacred myth, mighty living being, not meru base ornament or sculpture.

bedawang.aura: Living fiery cosmic Bedawang supporting Bali, stabilized by two separate nagas.

basis_claims.quote: Bedawang Nala (Bali: ᬩᭂᬤᬯᬂᬦᬮ) adalah seekor penyu raksasa dalam mitologi Bali yang membawa seluruh dunia di punggungnya. Dalam mitologi penciptaan dunia, ia merupakan perubahan dari Anantaboga. Ia bersama dua ular naga mendukung dunia manusia. Jikalau ia bergerak maka akan terjadilah gempa dan letusan gunung berapi di atas bumi.

statement.id: Bedawang Nala (ᬩᭂᬤᬯᬂᬦᬮ) adalah penyu raksasa dalam mitologi Bali yang memikul dunia di punggungnya; dalam mitos penciptaan ia perubahan dari Anantaboga, bersama dua naga menopang dunia manusia, dan bila bergerak terjadi gempa dan letusan gunung berapi.
statement.en: Bedawang Nala (ᬩᭂᬤᬯᬂᬦᬮ) is a giant turtle of Balinese mythology carrying the world on its back; in the creation myth it is a transformation of Anantaboga, supports the human world with two nāgas, and its movement causes earthquakes and volcanic eruptions.

basis_claims.quote: figuré par deux nāga (serpents mythiques), Naga Basuki et Naga Antaboga, qui représentent les besoins humains (nourriture, habillement, logement et sécurité) et agissent comme agents stabilisateurs

statement.id: Bedawang memikul dunia, digambarkan dengan dua naga, Naga Basuki dan Naga Antaboga, yang melambangkan kebutuhan manusia dan bertindak sebagai penstabil.
statement.en: Bedawang carries the world, shown with two nāgas, Naga Basuki and Naga Antaboga, representing human needs and acting as stabilizers.

basis_claims.quote: Ornamen ini umumnya diwujudkan sebagai seekor kura-kura raksasa berambut api dengan mulut menganga yang juga berapi.

statement.id: Ornamen ini umumnya digambarkan sebagai kura-kura raksasa berambut api dengan mulut menganga yang juga berapi.
statement.en: The ornament is generally shown as a giant turtle with fiery hair and a gaping mouth that is also fiery.

basis_claims.quote: Dua naga yang membelit sang kura-kura masing-masing bernama Naga Basuki dan Naga Anantabhoga

statement.id: Dua naga yang membelit kura-kura itu masing-masing bernama Naga Basuki dan Naga Anantabhoga.
statement.en: The two nagas coiling the turtle are named Naga Basuki and Naga Anantabhoga.

basis_claims.quote: diadaptasi menjadi konsepsi bedawang nala lokal Bali yang digambarkan berbentuk seekor kura-kura berapi raksasa di dasar laut yang memiliki karakter serupa

statement.id: Konsep kepala kuda betina berapi di dasar laut diadaptasi di Bali menjadi konsep bedawang nala yang digambarkan sebagai kura-kura berapi raksasa di dasar laut dengan karakter serupa.
statement.en: The concept of the fiery mare's head on the seabed was adapted in Bali into the local bedawang nala concept, depicted as a giant fiery turtle on the seabed with a similar character.

basis_claims.quote: Dalam mitologi rakyat Bali, digambarkan bahwa seekor kura-kura raksasa menyangga Pulau Bali di atas punggungnya. ... akan terjadi gempa bumi di Pulau Bali yang disangganya

statement.id: Dalam mitologi rakyat Bali, seekor kura-kura raksasa menyangga Pulau Bali di punggungnya, dan bila ia bergerak akan terjadi gempa bumi di Pulau Bali.
statement.en: In Balinese folk mythology a giant turtle supports the island of Bali on its back, and when it moves an earthquake occurs on the island.

basis_claims.quote: Kedua naga kosmik ini ditugaskan selalu mengawasi dan mencegah setiap pergerakan sang kura-kura penyangga pulau.

statement.id: Kedua naga kosmik itu ditugaskan selalu mengawasi dan mencegah setiap gerakan kura-kura penyangga pulau.
statement.en: The two cosmic nagas are charged with constantly watching and preventing any movement of the island-supporting turtle.

basis_claims.quote: In Javanese and Balinese mythology, it is depicted that a giant turtle supports an island on its back. If the giant turtle moves, an earthquake will occur.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Jawa dan Bali, seekor kura-kura raksasa digambarkan menyangga sebuah pulau di punggungnya; bila kura-kura itu bergerak, terjadi gempa bumi.
statement.en: In Javanese and Balinese mythology a giant turtle is depicted supporting an island on its back; if the turtle moves, an earthquake occurs.

warak-ngendog.depicted_variant: Living pakem Warak with goat body, camel neck, red dragon head, curly feathers and egg between forelegs.

visual_requirements.description: A LIVING SEMARANG WARAK NGENDOG, imagined four-legged TAILED creature with GOAT-LIKE BODY, LONG CAMEL-LIKE NECK and DRAGON HEAD (c15,c16), exactly four goat legs and one tail, NO wings. Gaping fanged dragon mouth, RED HEAD AND NECK (c24), covered in eye-catching physically coloured CURLY UPSIDE-DOWN FEATHERS like pitik walik, red/yellow/white (c06,c15). One WHITE EGG rests on ground at front BETWEEN TWO FORELEGS, echoing documented placement c14 and purity c19. Proud energetic walking pose on Semarang earth with distant old market/mosque roof silhouette, warm natural light. Flesh, muscle, feathers and hooves clearly alive, not wooden frame, paper toy, parade statue, giraffe/lion variant or ornament. Composite anatomy unmistakable and readable, no generic magical aura.

warak-ngendog.aura: Living pakem Warak with goat body, camel neck, red dragon head, curly feathers and egg between forelegs.

basis_claims.quote: warak ngendog juga tampak diselimuti bulu-bulu yang menempel secara terbalik. Bulu-bulu ini punya beragam warna yang mencolok mata, mulai dari merah, kuning, hingga putih terang.

statement.id: Warak ngendog tampak diselimuti bulu-bulu yang menempel terbalik, dengan warna mencolok dari merah, kuning, hingga putih terang.
statement.en: The warak ngendog is covered in feathers attached upside down, in eye-catching colours from red and yellow to bright white.

basis_claims.quote: Agar anak menjadi semakin senang maka pada bagian depan di antara kedua kakinya ditempatkan sebuah telur.

statement.id: Menurut kajian ini, agar anak-anak makin senang, sebuah telur diletakkan di bagian depan di antara kedua kaki mainan itu.
statement.en: According to this study, to please children more, an egg was placed at the front, between the toy's two legs.

basis_claims.quote: bentuk Warak Ngendog merepresentasikan binatang rekaan sebagai hewan berkaki empat, berekor, berbadan seperti kambing, berleher panjang seperti unta, berkepala naga dan seluruh tubuhnya berbulu keriting seperti bulu pitik walik berwarna-warni.

statement.id: Bentuk warak ngendog adalah binatang rekaan berkaki empat dan berekor, berbadan seperti kambing, berleher panjang seperti unta, berkepala naga, dan seluruh tubuhnya berbulu keriting warna-warni seperti bulu pitik walik.
statement.en: The warak ngendog is an imagined four-legged, tailed animal with a goat-like body, a long camel-like neck, a dragon head and a body covered in colourful curly feathers like those of the pitik walik.

basis_claims.quote: oleh masyarakat luas dimaknai sebagai simbol akulturasi budaya atas dasar pertimbangan karena keseluruhan perupaannya merepresentasikan simbol budaya tiga etnis warga masyarakat Kota Semarang, yaitu etnis Jawa (melalui perupaan badan kambing), etnis Arab (melalui perupaan leher unta), dan etnis Cina (melalui perupaan kepala naga).

statement.id: Masyarakat luas memaknai warak ngendog sebagai simbol akulturasi budaya karena perupaannya mewakili tiga etnis warga Semarang: Jawa (badan kambing), Arab (leher unta), dan Cina (kepala naga).
statement.en: The wider community reads the warak ngendog as a symbol of cultural acculturation because its form represents three ethnic groups of Semarang: Javanese (goat body), Arab (camel neck) and Chinese (dragon head).

basis_claims.quote: Telur adalah simbol kesucian layaknya janin yang ada dalam kandungan yang masih suci dari segala dosa.

statement.id: Menurut informan penelitian ini, telur adalah simbol kesucian, seperti janin dalam kandungan yang masih suci dari segala dosa.
statement.en: According to the study's informants, the egg is a symbol of purity, like a foetus in the womb that is still free of all sin.

basis_claims.quote: Hewan berbentuk imajiner, mulut menganga dan bertaring, leher dan kepala bewarna merah, dan struktur bentuk tubuh bergaris lurus.

statement.id: Bentuk tradisional (pakem) warak ngendog digambarkan sebagai hewan imajiner bermulut menganga dan bertaring, berleher dan berkepala merah, dengan tubuh bergaris lurus.
statement.en: The traditional (pakem) form of the warak ngendog is described as an imaginary animal with a gaping, fanged mouth, a red neck and head, and a straight-lined body.

krasue.depicted_variant: Floating detached Krasue head with non-gory hanging viscera and faint lamp-like glow.

visual_requirements.description: KRASUE, Thai nocturnal female spirit, one DISembodied living woman's HEAD floats over rural fields with clearly recognizable internal organs and looping entrails hanging from neck; NO torso, arms, legs or wings (c01,c06,c10). Non-gory fictional spirit anatomy: intact softly translucent heart/lung-like organs and pale curved intestinal loops, no dripping blood, open wounds or torn flesh. Long dark hair is editorial. Face unnervingly alert, cold direct gaze. Faint localized lamp-like WILL-O'-THE-WISP LUMINESCENCE around head and hanging organs (c02,c11) is restrained, not neon or energy ribbons. Low camera and foreground spirit dominate frame with distant small village rooftops and banana/rice fields under natural night (c07,c09). No victims; chilling intimate atmospheric horror.

krasue.aura: Floating detached Krasue head with non-gory hanging viscera and faint lamp-like glow.

basis_claims.quote: is a nocturnal female spirit of Southeast Asian folklore . It manifests as the floating, disembodied head of a woman, usually young and beautiful, with her internal organs still attached and trailing down from the neck.

statement.id: Krasue adalah roh wanita nokturnal dalam cerita rakyat Asia Tenggara yang berwujud kepala melayang dengan organ dalam menjuntai.
statement.en: Krasue is a nocturnal female spirit of Southeast Asian folklore manifesting as a floating head with trailing internal organs.

basis_claims.quote: According to Thai ethnographer Phraya Anuman Rajadhon , the Krasue is accompanied by a will-o'-the-wisp -like luminescent glow.

statement.id: Menurut etnografer Thai, Krasue disertai oleh pendaran cahaya mirip api rawa.
statement.en: According to Thai ethnographer Phraya Anuman Rajadhon, the Krasue is accompanied by a will-o'-the-wisp-like luminescent glow.

basis_claims.quote: these regional variations all share in common that they are characterized by a disembodied woman's head with organs and entrails hanging from its neck.

statement.id: Berbagai variasi daerah ini memiliki kesamaan berupa wujud kepala wanita melayang dengan organ dan isi perut menjuntai.
statement.en: These regional variations all share in common being characterized by a disembodied woman's head with organs and entrails hanging from the neck.

basis_claims.quote: Floating in the air in rural parts of Thailand and the rest of Southeast Asia, the disembodied ghost of the Krasue is hunting for blood.

statement.id: Melayang di udara pedesaan Thailand dan bagian lain Asia Tenggara, hantu Krasue berburu darah.
statement.en: Floating in the air in rural parts of Thailand and the rest of Southeast Asia, the disembodied ghost of the Krasue hunts for blood.

basis_claims.quote: Krasue is a night creature that floats, haunting fields, villages, and the spaces between human life and the unseen world.

statement.id: Krasue adalah makhluk malam yang melayang, menghantui ladang, desa, dan ruang kehidupan manusia.
statement.en: Krasue is a night creature that floats, haunting fields, villages, and the spaces of human life.

basis_claims.quote: While exact details differ by region, the core of the legend remains consistent: Krasue is a detached head with its internal organs trailing below like shimmering tendrils.

statement.id: Inti legenda tetap sama di mana Krasue adalah kepala terpisah dengan organ dalam menjuntai di bawahnya.
statement.en: The core of the legend remains consistent that Krasue is a detached head with internal organs trailing below like shimmering tendrils.

basis_claims.quote: Her head glows faintly in the dark, often compared to a flickering lamp or a will-o’-the-wisp, floating in the air.

statement.id: Kepalanya berpendar samar di kegelapan mirip lentera atau api rawa saat melayang di udara.
statement.en: Her head glows faintly in the dark, often compared to a flickering lamp or will-o'-the-wisp floating in the air.

nang-tani.depicted_variant: Green-skinned green-dressed Nang Tani with red lips and hovering bare feet among wild banana trees.

visual_requirements.description: NANG TANI, beautiful living Thai banana-tree spirit with GREENISH SKIN, RED LIPS like ripe ivy gourd, thick BLACK loose hair, traditional opaque GREEN THAI DRESS (c04,c05), one head two arms two legs, both BARE FEET HOVER a few inches clear of ground and a small visible ground shadow (c05). Emerges protectively between broad-leaf WILD BANANA TRUNKS at village-outskirts field edge in full-moon night (c01,c04,c07), trunk tied with physical coloured satin and small flowers/incense offerings (c06). Her benevolent uncanny direct gaze, gently poised hand and unmistakable skin/hovering establish spirit presence. Natural silvery moonlight, rich leaves and skin tones, no luminous green mist, light beam, wings, body dissolving into tree or modern film/cartoon designs.

nang-tani.aura: Green-skinned green-dressed Nang Tani with red lips and hovering bare feet among wild banana trees.

basis_claims.quote: Nang Tani (Thai: นางตานี; "Lady of Tani") is a female spirit of the Thai folklore. According to folk tradition, this ghost appears as a young woman that haunts wild banana trees (Musa acuminata), known in Thai language as Kluai Tani (กล้วยตานี).

statement.id: Nang Tani (นางตานี, 'Nona dari Tani') adalah roh perempuan dalam cerita rakyat Thailand; menurut tradisi, hantu ini tampil sebagai perempuan muda yang menghuni pohon pisang liar yang disebut kluai tani.
statement.en: Nang Tani (นางตานี, 'Lady of Tani') is a female spirit of Thai folklore; by tradition this ghost appears as a young woman haunting wild banana trees called kluai tani.

basis_claims.quote: This ghost inhabits the clumps of wild banana trees and is popularly represented as a beautiful young woman wearing a green traditional Thai costume. Most of the time Phi Tani remains hidden, but she comes out of the tree and becomes visible especially on full moon nights.

statement.id: Hantu ini menghuni rumpun pisang liar dan digambarkan sebagai perempuan muda cantik berbusana tradisional Thai hijau; ia biasanya bersembunyi, tetapi keluar dan terlihat terutama pada malam purnama.
statement.en: This ghost dwells in wild banana clumps and is pictured as a beautiful young woman in green Thai dress; she usually hides but comes out and is seen especially on full-moon nights.

basis_claims.quote: She has a greenish complexion, blending with the tree, but her lips have the red color of the ripe ivy gourd. Her hair is black, abundant and untied. She generally appears in a standing position and her feet don't touch the ground, but hover slightly above it.

statement.id: Kulitnya kehijauan menyatu dengan pohon, bibirnya merah seperti buah pepasan masak, rambutnya hitam lebat terurai, dan kakinya melayang sedikit di atas tanah.
statement.en: Her skin is greenish, blending with the tree, her lips red like ripe ivy gourd, her hair black, thick and loose, and her feet hover slightly above the ground.

basis_claims.quote: It is considered a bad omen to cut trees from the clump Tani inhabits. Offerings are made to her in the form of sweets, incense sticks and flowers. People also often tie a length of colored satin cloth around the trunk of the banana tree believed to be haunted by her.

statement.id: Menebang pohon dari rumpun yang dihuni Tani dianggap pertanda buruk; orang memberinya kue manis, dupa, dan bunga, serta mengikatkan kain satin berwarna pada batang pohonnya.
statement.en: Cutting trees from Tani's clump is a bad omen; people offer sweets, incense and flowers, and tie coloured satin around the trunk.

basis_claims.quote: Owing to their connection with ghosts, people prefer not to have them growing near their homes and they are not found within village compounds. However, clumps of this tree are found not far from inhabited areas, often at the outskirts of villages or at the edge of cultivated fields by the roadside.

statement.id: Karena kaitannya dengan hantu, orang tidak mau pohon ini tumbuh dekat rumah; rumpunnya sering ada di pinggir desa atau di tepi ladang dekat jalan.
statement.en: Because of the ghostly link, people avoid growing it near homes; clumps are often at village outskirts or at the edge of fields by the road.

basis_claims.quote: Legends of the Thai oral tradition say that this spirit may harm men, especially those who have wronged women, but she is mostly considered benevolent. Nang Tani generally has a gentle disposition and may give food to passing Buddhist monks.

statement.id: Legenda lisan Thai menyebut roh ini dapat mencelakai laki-laki, terutama yang menyakiti perempuan, tetapi umumnya ia dianggap baik hati dan dapat memberi makanan kepada biksu yang lewat.
statement.en: Thai oral legend says this spirit may harm men, especially those who wronged women, but she is mostly seen as benevolent and may give food to passing monks.

sarimanok.depicted_variant: Living colourful spiral-crested Sarimanok bearing a fish in its beak beside Maranao standards.

visual_requirements.description: A LIVING MARANAO SARIMANOK legendary fowl of Mindanao (c01,c02), one bird head, two wings, TWO bird legs/talons and one glorious feathered tail. Vivid physically pigmented red, yellow, green and blue wing/tail feathers; head crest feathers naturally curl into clearly visible scroll/leaf/SPIRAL shapes interpreting documented head motifs (c02), never metal ornamental sculpture. One intact small FISH visibly carried in BEAK (c02,c15), no gore. Magnificent alert regal pose with wings partly lifted by high lake-region shore (c08); a few distant traditional flags and standards preserve c04 display context. Natural sunrise glints on feather colour, commanding mythical totem appearance through spectacular feather silhouette and fish rather than generic glowing bird. Not a wooden carving, toy, phoenix firebird or ordinary rooster.

sarimanok.aura: Living colourful spiral-crested Sarimanok bearing a fish in its beak beside Maranao standards.

basis_claims.quote: also known as papanok in its feminine form, is a legendary bird of the Maranao people, who originate from Mindanao, an island in the Philippines, and part of Philippine mythology. It comes from the words sari and manok. Sari means "assorted" or "various", while manok originally meant "bird"

statement.id: Sarimanok, bentuk betinanya papanok, adalah burung legenda orang Maranao dari Mindanao, Filipina; namanya dari sari ('beraneka') dan manok (semula 'burung', kini 'ayam').
statement.en: The sarimanok, papanok in its female form, is a legendary bird of the Maranao of Mindanao, Philippines; its name comes from sari ('assorted') and manok (originally 'bird', now 'chicken').

basis_claims.quote: It is portrayed as a fowl with colorful wings and a feathered tail, carrying a fish in its beak or talons. The head is profusely decorated with scroll, leaf, and spiral motifs. It is said to be a symbol of good fortune.

statement.id: Sarimanok digambarkan sebagai unggas bersayap warna-warni dan berekor bulu yang membawa ikan di paruh atau cakar, berkepala penuh motif gulungan, daun, dan spiral, dan melambangkan keberuntungan.
statement.en: The sarimanok is shown as a fowl with colourful wings and feathered tail carrying a fish in beak or talons, its head full of scroll, leaf and spiral motifs, and symbolizes good fortune.

basis_claims.quote: According to the tradition, the sarimanok is never displayed by itself. It must be displayed with the set of flags, standards and vexilloids.

statement.id: Menurut tradisi, sarimanok tidak pernah dipajang sendirian, tetapi bersama seperangkat bendera dan panji.
statement.en: By tradition the sarimanok is never displayed alone but with a set of flags and standards.

basis_claims.quote: The ivory knob is shaped as a stylized bird, the mythical sarimanok – the symbol of Maranao royalty, its people and of the high lake region they are associated with.

statement.id: Pada sebuah danganan, kenop gadingnya berbentuk burung bergaya, yaitu sarimanok mitos, lambang kebangsawanan Maranao, rakyatnya, dan wilayah danau tinggi yang berkaitan dengan mereka.
statement.en: On a danganan, the ivory knob is shaped as a stylized bird, the mythical sarimanok, the symbol of Maranao royalty, its people and the high lake region they are associated with.

basis_claims.quote: The fish on the beak of the Sarimanok symbolises the food that the Maranao people offer to the spirit world.

statement.id: Ikan di paruh Sarimanok melambangkan makanan yang dipersembahkan orang Maranao kepada dunia roh.
statement.en: The fish on the sarimanok's beak symbolises the food that the Maranao offer to the spirit world.

basis_claims.quote: The Maranaos believe that the Sarimanok will bring them good fortune and if the spirits are pleased, they will have a bountiful harvest.

statement.id: Orang Maranao percaya Sarimanok membawa keberuntungan, dan bila roh senang, panen mereka akan melimpah.
statement.en: The Maranao believe the sarimanok brings good fortune and, if the spirits are pleased, a bountiful harvest.

singa-mythology.depicted_variant: Living Batak human-buffalo-reptile Singa with elongated face, bulging eyes, defined nose and spiral beard.

visual_requirements.description: A LIVING BATAK SINGA GUARDIAN, not a zoological lion (c01,c02), documented blend HUMAN, WATER BUFFALO and CROCODILE/LIZARD. One long expressive face with bulging eyes, clearly defined humanlike nose and long SPIRAL BEARD (c01), physical buffalo-like head/horn structure and powerful buffalo shoulders joining a long low scaled crocodile-like body and tail, FOUR coherent reptile legs; exact composite arrangement is editorial reading of c01,c06, not a fixed researched limb formula. Majestic benevolent protective gaze, alert grounded stance before distant Batak ancestral house (c03,c09), creature fills frame. Natural earth, black and warm ochre palette informed by c15 traditional colourwork; realistic scales and living hair, not carved vessel, statue or toy. No wing, glowing energy, lion mane, armour or human riders.

singa-mythology.aura: Living Batak human-buffalo-reptile Singa with elongated face, bulging eyes, defined nose and spiral beard.

basis_claims.quote: Singa is an apotropaic figure from the mythology of the Batak people of North Sumatra, Indonesia. The singa represents a benevolent and protective power. The singa is described as "part human, part water buffalo, and part crocodile or lizard". It is variedly represented, but always has an elongated face, with big bulging eyes, a well-defined nose, and long spiraling beard.

statement.id: Singa adalah sosok penolak bala dari mitologi Batak di Sumatra Utara, Indonesia, yang melambangkan kekuatan pelindung yang baik; ia digambarkan sebagai campuran manusia, kerbau air, dan buaya atau kadal, berwajah panjang dengan mata besar melotot, hidung tegas, dan janggut panjang berpilin.
statement.en: The singa is an apotropaic figure of Batak mythology, North Sumatra, Indonesia, representing benevolent protective power; described as part human, part water buffalo and part crocodile or lizard, with an elongated face, bulging eyes, a defined nose and a long spiral beard.

basis_claims.quote: The word singa is derived from the Sanskrit singa, "lion". The Batak term singa has a predominantly magical - rather than zoological - meaning, so it does not symbolize a lion, but Nāga or Boru Saniang Naga, the primeval water serpent from the Hindu-Buddhist mythology.

statement.id: Kata singa berasal dari Sanskerta singa ('singa'); dalam bahasa Batak maknanya magis, bukan zoologis, sehingga tidak melambangkan singa, melainkan Naga atau Boru Saniang Naga, ular air purba mitologi Hindu-Buddha.
statement.en: Singa comes from Sanskrit singa ('lion'); in Batak its meaning is magical, not zoological, symbolizing not a lion but the Nāga or Boru Saniang Naga, the primeval water serpent of Hindu-Buddhist mythology.

basis_claims.quote: Images of singa are carved in various objects such as domestic utensils, medicine containers, jewelries, amulets, wood coffins, stone sarcophagi, barns, and Batak traditional houses. Its frequent use made the singa a symbol of the Batak culture. Carving of singa on a Batak house is called singa ni ruma

statement.id: Gambar singa diukir pada perkakas, wadah obat, perhiasan, jimat, peti mati, sarkofagus, lumbung, dan rumah adat Batak, sehingga menjadi lambang budaya Batak; ukiran pada rumah disebut singa ni ruma.
statement.en: Singa images are carved on utensils, medicine containers, jewellery, amulets, coffins, sarcophagi, barns and Batak houses, making it a Batak cultural symbol; on houses it is called singa ni ruma.

basis_claims.quote: It is often represented only with its head, but sometimes it may also be represented full body. Other figures - such as other protective deity or ancestral figures - may also be represented standing or sitting on top of the head of the singa.

statement.id: Singa sering digambarkan hanya kepalanya, tetapi kadang juga seluruh badan; sosok lain, seperti dewa pelindung atau sosok leluhur, dapat digambarkan berdiri atau duduk di atas kepalanya.
